rows.question: What is the current building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code of the history department?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dlc_core AS (
  SELECT
    `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS `DLC_KEY`,
    NULLIF(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(`BUILDING_NAME`, ''),
        NULLIF(`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, ''),
        NULLIF(`BUILDING_NAMED_FOR`, '')
      ),
      ''
    ) AS `DLC_NAME`,
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
  FROM `fac_building`
  GROUP BY `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY`, `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, `BUILDING_NAME`, `BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, `BUILDING_NAMED_FOR`
)
SELECT
  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ',
    NULLIF(addr.`ADDRESS_LINE1`, ''),
    NULLIF(addr.`ADDRESS_LINE2`, ''),
    NULLIF(addr.`ADDRESS_LINE3`, '')
  )) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  addr.CITY,
  addr.STATE,
  addr.POSTAL_CODE
FROM dlc_core d
JOIN fac_building b
  ON d.DLC_KEY = b.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY
JOIN fac_building_address addr
  ON b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = addr.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE LOWER(d.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND addr.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show the unique activity titles, locations, term start date, and supervisor name for all independent activities, sorted by the ascending order of start date.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_person_roles AS (
SELECT
  isp.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
  isp.PERSON_ROLE,
  isp.PERSON_NAME,
  isp.PERSON_EMAIL,
  isp.PERSON_ORGANIZATION
FROM
  iap_subject_person isp
WHERE
  isp.PERSON_NAME IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS activity_title,
  s.SESSION_LOCATION AS location,
  a.TERM_START_DATE AS term_start_date,
  p.PERSON_NAME AS supervisor_name
FROM (
  SELECT
    d.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE ASC) AS rn
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_session s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN iap_subject_person p ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
  JOIN academic_terms a ON d.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
  WHERE p.PERSON_ROLE = 'Activity leader'
    AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND d.ACTIVITY_TITLE <> ''
    AND s.SESSION_LOCATION IS NOT NULL AND s.SESSION_LOCATION <> ''
    AND a.TERM_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND a.TERM_START_DATE <> ''
    AND p.PERSON_NAME IS NOT NULL AND p.PERSON_NAME <> ''
) AS d
JOIN iap_subject_session s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_person p ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY = p.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY
JOIN academic_terms a ON d.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE
WHERE d.rn = 1
ORDER BY a.TERM_START_DATE ASC

rows.question: List the unique course instructor names, course titles, and the amount of material for each course instructor key and the key of subject offered.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lci.COURSE_NAME,
  td.RECORD_COUNT AS AMOUNT_OF_MATERIAL,
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
  td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
  td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
  td.TERM_CODE,
  td.SUBJECT_ID
FROM (
  SELECT
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.COURSE_NAME,
    UPPER(TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.COURSE_NAME, '[[:punct:]]', ' '), '\\s+', ' '))) AS COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED,
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    UPPER(
      TRIM(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, '(?i)\\b(DR|PROF|PROFESSOR|MR|MRS|MS)\\.?\\b', ' '),
            '[[:punct:]]', ' '
          ),
          '\\s+', ' '
        )
      )
    ) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED,
    TRIM(lci.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT,
    TRIM(lci.UNIT) AS UNIT,
    TRIM(lci.DATE_FROM) AS DATE_FROM,
    TRIM(lci.DATE_TO) AS DATE_TO
  FROM library_course_instructor lci
) AS lci
JOIN tip_detail td
  ON (
       lci.COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED = UPPER(TRIM(td.SUBJECT_ID))
       OR lci.COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED = UPPER(TRIM(td.SUBJECT_TITLE))
       OR lci.COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED = UPPER(TRIM(td.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID))
     )
WHERE td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND td.RECORD_COUNT IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME ASC,
         lci.COURSE_NAME ASC,
         td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ASC

rows.question: List the unique full room names, their corresponding building names, street addresses, cities, states, postal codes, and building heights for rooms associated with subjects that Computer Science students can enroll in.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subjects_cs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cc.SUBJECT_ID,
    cc.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cc.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    cc.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
  FROM `cis_course_catalog` cc
  WHERE cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
),
sections_cs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    so.SECTION_ID,
    so.MEET_PLACE,
    so.MEET_TIME,
    so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_ID,
    so.SUBJECT_CODE,
    so.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` so
  JOIN subjects_cs s
    ON (
         (so.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND s.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID)
      OR (so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND so.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
      OR (so.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND s.SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND so.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE AND so.SUBJECT_NUMBER = s.SUBJECT_NUMBER)
    )
),
rooms_extracted AS (
  SELECT
    sc.SECTION_ID,
    sc.MEET_PLACE,
    TRIM(sc.MEET_PLACE) AS MEET_PLACE_TRIM,
    sc.SUBJECT_ID,
    sc.SUBJECT_CODE,
    sc.SUBJECT_NUMBER
  FROM sections_cs sc
  WHERE sc.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sc.MEET_PLACE) <> ''
),
-- Note: fac_building_address columns were truncated in the prompt; use likely existing column names:
-- common names: ADDRESS_LINE_1, STREET, CITY, STATE, POSTAL_CODE, ADDRESS_PURPOSE, FAC_BUILDING_KEY
buildings_matched AS (
  SELECT
    r.SECTION_ID,
    r.MEET_PLACE,
    r.MEET_PLACE_TRIM,
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
    fb.LATITUDE_WGS,
    fb.LONGITUDE_WGS,
    -- include only the address columns we expect may exist; if some do not exist in the actual schema this will need adjustment.
    -- Use fba.ADDRESS_LINE_1 (common) and fba.STREET as alternatives; if not present in schema, replace with existing names.
    fba.ADDRESS_LINE_1 AS FBA_ADDRESS_LINE_1,
    fba.STREET AS FBA_STREET,
    fba.CITY AS FBA_CITY,
    fba.STATE AS FBA_STATE,
    fba.POSTAL_CODE AS FBA_POSTAL_CODE,
    fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE AS FBA_ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
    b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS BLDG_STREET_FROM_BUILDINGS,
    b.BUILDING_NAME AS BLDG_NAME_FROM_BUILDINGS
  FROM rooms_extracted r
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON (
        (fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NAME <> '' AND INSTR(LOWER(r.MEET_PLACE_TRIM), LOWER(fb.BUILDING_NAME)) > 0)
        OR
        (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND INSTR(r.MEET_PLACE_TRIM, fb.BUILDING_NUMBER) > 0)
       )
  LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
    ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
),
final_rooms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(gr.MEET_PLACE), ''),
      NULLIF(gr.BUILDING_NAME, ''),
      NULLIF(gr.BLDG_NAME_FROM_BUILDINGS, '')
    ) AS FULL_ROOM_NAME,
    gr.BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(gr.FBA_STREET, ''), NULLIF(gr.FBA_ADDRESS_LINE_1, ''), NULLIF(gr.BLDG_STREET_FROM_BUILDINGS, '')) AS STREET_ADDRESS,
    NULLIF(gr.FBA_CITY, '') AS CITY,
    NULLIF(gr.FBA_STATE, '') AS STATE,
    NULLIF(gr.FBA_POSTAL_CODE, '') AS POSTAL_CODE,
    gr.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
    gr.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings_matched gr
  WHERE COALESCE(gr.BUILDING_NAME, gr.BLDG_NAME_FROM_BUILDINGS) IS NOT NULL
    OR gr.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  FULL_ROOM_NAME,
  BUILDING_NAME,
  STREET_ADDRESS,
  CITY,
  STATE,
  POSTAL_CODE,
  BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM final_rooms
ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME, FULL_ROOM_NAME

rows.question: List the unique term code, subject title, room, floor, building key, building street address, city, state, and postal code, formats, and number of enrolled students for all courses with more than 300 attendees.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  DISTINCT
  ct.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
  dc.MEET_PLACE AS ROOM,
  dc.FLOOR AS FLOOR,
  b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  addr.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  addr.CITY AS CITY,
  addr.STATE AS STATE,
  addr.POSTAL_CODE AS POSTAL_CODE,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS FORMATS,
  COALESCE(dc.ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) AS ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM
  course_catalog_subject_offered AS so
JOIN
  drupal_course_catalog AS dc
  ON so.SECTION_ID = dc.SECTION_ID
LEFT JOIN
  fac_building AS b
  ON dc.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN
  (
    SELECT
      FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
      BUILDING_NUMBER,
      BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
      CITY,
      STATE,
      POSTAL_CODE,
      ADDRESS_PURPOSE
    FROM fac_building_address
    WHERE ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
  ) AS addr
  ON b.BUILDING_NUMBER = addr.BUILDING_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN
  academic_terms AS ct
  ON so.TERM_CODE = ct.TERM_CODE
WHERE
  COALESCE(dc.ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0) > 300

rows.question: What are the subject titles, their material titles, ISBN numbers, and total costs of new materials for each subject title?

WITH tip_subject_material_link AS (
  SELECT
    td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    tso.`TERM_CODE`,
    tso.`SUBJECT_ID`
  FROM `tip_detail` td

)

rows.question: List the long names of buildings constructed before 1950 that have more than 100 employees, the built year of the building, and number of employees.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_building_base AS (
SELECT
  `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
  `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  `DATE_BUILT` AS DATE_BUILT,
  `NUM_OF_ROOMS` AS NUM_OF_ROOMS,
  `EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  `ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS COST_COLLECTOR_KEY
FROM `fac_building`
),
fac_building_with_room_metrics AS (
SELECT
  b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
  b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  b.`DATE_BUILT` AS `DATE_BUILT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`ROOM_COUNT`, 0) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`,
  -- NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY is a simple proxy: one employee per X square feet.
  -- The divisor is a literal and should be supplied/adjusted outside the view if needed.
  -- Here we use 150 sqft per employee as the proxy divisor lifted out as a literal.
  FLOOR(COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) / 150) AS `NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY`
FROM
  fac_building b
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregated room metrics per building
  SELECT
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`) AS `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
    COUNT(*) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
    -- prefer assignable area where available, else use ext gross area per-room if provided.
    SUM(COALESCE(rb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`, rb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`, 0)) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`
  FROM
    fac_building rb
  -- rooms may be stored in a related table in some schemas; if there were a fac_room table
  -- you'd aggregate from that table instead. Here we conservatively treat fac_building rows
  -- that include NUM_OF_ROOMS and assignable area as proxies for room-level counts.
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
) room_aggr
  ON room_aggr.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
)
SELECT
  BUILDING_NAME AS long_name,
  CAST(RIGHT(DATE_BUILT,4) AS UNSIGNED) AS built_year,
  NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY AS num_employees
FROM fac_building_with_room_metrics
WHERE
  DATE_BUILT REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{1,2}/[0-9]{4}$'
  AND CAST(RIGHT(DATE_BUILT,4) AS UNSIGNED) < 1950
  AND NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY > 100
ORDER BY built_year ASC

rows.question: For each building key, what is the building name and the number of courses offered by the Center for International Studies?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.SECTION_ID) AS COURSE_COUNT
FROM buildings b
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered co
  ON (
    -- resolve meeting place to building: MEET_PLACE may contain building number or building name.
    -- match when MEET_PLACE equals BUILDING_NUMBER or contains BUILDING_NUMBER (common) or equals BUILDING_NAME
    (co.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        co.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
        OR co.MEET_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', b.BUILDING_NUMBER, '%')
        OR co.MEET_PLACE = b.BUILDING_NAME
        OR co.MEET_PLACE LIKE CONCAT('%', b.BUILDING_NAME, '%')
      )
    )
  )
WHERE
  -- restrict to CIS courses by department code/name/title containing CIS or Center for International Studies (case-insensitive)
  (
    (co.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(co.DEPARTMENT_CODE) LIKE '%cis%')
    OR (co.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(co.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE '%cis%')
    OR (co.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(co.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE '%center for international studies%')
    OR (co.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(co.SUBJECT_TITLE) LIKE '%center for international studies%')
    OR (co.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(co.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION) LIKE '%center for international studies%')
  )
  -- only count rows with a section identifier to avoid counting meeting sessions multiple times; SECTION_ID is used as the distinct identifier
  AND co.SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY
  COURSE_COUNT DESC

rows.question: What is the name of the building that accomodates the most students, and how many students does it accomodate?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_capacity AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`,
    COALESCE(`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`, `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE`) AS area_sqft
  FROM `buildings`
),
-- Estimate students accommodated by assuming 150 sqft per student when assignable area present,
-- otherwise 200 sqft per student when only gross area available.
students_estimate AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`,
    CASE
      WHEN `BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` IS NOT NULL AND `BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` > 0
        THEN FLOOR(`BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` / 150)
      WHEN `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` IS NOT NULL AND `BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` > 0
        THEN FLOOR(`BLDG_GROSS_SQUARE_FOOTAGE` / 200)
      ELSE 0
    END AS accommodated_students
  FROM `buildings`
)
SELECT
  `BUILDING_KEY`,
  `BUILDING_NAME`,
  `accommodated_students`
FROM students_estimate
ORDER BY accommodated_students DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: List the name and floor of the building with the largest floor number.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  fbb.BUILDING_NAME,
  ff.FLOOR
FROM fac_floor AS ff
JOIN (
  SELECT
    f.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    NULLIF(f.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS BUILDING_NAME
  FROM fac_building f
) AS fbb
  ON ff.BUILDING_KEY = fbb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: For each IAP category and academic year, list the category name, academic year, total fee collected, total number of IAP subjects, and the minimum and maximum enrollment.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_category AS (
  SELECT
    `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`,
    `IAP_CATEGORY_NAME`
  FROM `iap_subject_category`
),
iap_subject_detail_clean AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(iap.`IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`, NULL) AS `IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY`,
    iap.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    TRIM(iap.`ACTIVITY_TITLE`) AS `ACTIVITY_TITLE`,
    CASE
      WHEN iap.`FEE` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(iap.`FEE`) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(
        NULLIF(
          REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(iap.`FEE`), '$', ''), ',', ''), '(', '-'), ')', '')
        , '') AS DECIMAL(18,2)
      )
    END AS `FEE`,
    CASE
      WHEN iap.`MAX_ENROLLMENT` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(iap.`MAX_ENROLLMENT`) = '' THEN NULL
      ELSE CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(iap.`MAX_ENROLLMENT`), '^[0-9]+'), '') AS SIGNED)
    END AS `MAX_ENROLLMENT`,
    NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM(iap.`ATTENDANCE`), ''), '') AS `ATTENDANCE`
  FROM `iap_subject_detail` AS iap
)
SELECT
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  d.TERM_CODE AS academic_year,
  SUM(COALESCE(d.FEE, 0)) AS total_fee_collected,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(COALESCE(d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,''), '||', COALESCE(d.TERM_CODE,''), '||', COALESCE(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE,''))) AS total_iap_subjects,
  MIN(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment,
  MAX(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment
FROM iap_subject_detail_clean d
JOIN iap_category c
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WHERE d.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  d.TERM_CODE
ORDER BY
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ASC,
  d.TERM_CODE ASC

fac_building_base AS (

library_course_instructor_normalized AS (
SELECT
  -- primary key carried through
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,

  -- raw course name as provided
  lci.COURSE_NAME,

  -- normalized course name: trim, collapse internal spaces, uppercase,
  -- remove punctuation commonly interfering with joins, and keep numeric parts
  UPPER(
    TRIM(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.COURSE_NAME, '[[:punct:]]', ' '),    -- replace punctuation with space
        '\\s+', ' '                                             -- collapse multiple spaces to single
      )
    )
  ) AS COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED,

  -- raw instructor name as provided
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,

  -- normalized instructor name: trim, collapse spaces, uppercase,
  -- remove punctuation, remove titles (Dr, Prof, Mr, Mrs, Ms) for better matching
  UPPER(
    TRIM(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, '(?i)\\b(DR|PROF|PROFESSOR|MR|MRS|MS)\\.?\\b', ' '), -- remove common titles
          '[[:punct:]]', ' '                                                          -- replace punctuation
        ),
        '\\s+', ' '
      )
    )
  ) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED,

  -- department and unit carried through (trimmed)
  TRIM(lci.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT,
  TRIM(lci.UNIT) AS UNIT,

  -- date range fields: keep as-is but trimmed; consumers can parse further
  TRIM(lci.DATE_FROM) AS DATE_FROM,

FROM library_course_instructor lci
),
iap_subject_person AS (
SELECT
  ipa.`IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY` AS IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
  -- canonical person name: prefer PERSON_NAME from iap_person_roles (clean joinable projection)
  ipa.`PERSON_NAME` AS PERSON_NAME,
  -- affiliation: use PERSON_ORGANIZATION from iap_person_roles as the MIT affiliation field
  ipa.`PERSON_ORGANIZATION` AS PERSON_MIT_AFFILIATION,

fac_building_with_room_metrics AS (
SELECT
  b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
  b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  b.`DATE_BUILT` AS `DATE_BUILT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`ROOM_COUNT`, 0) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`,
  -- NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY is a simple proxy: one employee per X square feet.
  -- The divisor is a literal and should be supplied/adjusted outside the view if needed.
  -- Here we use 150 sqft per employee as the proxy divisor lifted out as a literal.
  FLOOR(COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) / 150) AS `NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY`
FROM
  fac_building b
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregated room metrics per building
  SELECT
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`) AS `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
    COUNT(*) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
    -- prefer assignable area where available, else use ext gross area per-room if provided.
    SUM(COALESCE(rb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`, rb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`, 0)) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`
  FROM
    fac_building rb
  -- rooms may be stored in a related table in some schemas; if there were a fac_room table
  -- you'd aggregate from that table instead. Here we conservatively treat fac_building rows
  -- that include NUM_OF_ROOMS and assignable area as proxies for room-level counts.
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
) room_aggr
  ON room_aggr.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
),
iap_subject_detail_raw AS (

  iapid.IS_CANCELLED

rows.question: What is the term code, term description, total number of IAP sessions, total fee collected, and minimum and maximum enrollment for each term code?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COALESCE(COUNT(iap.SESSION_ID), 0) AS TOTAL_IAP_SESSIONS,
  COALESCE(SUM(iap.FEE_COLLECTED), 0) AS TOTAL_FEE_COLLECTED,
  MIN(iap.ENROLLMENT) AS MIN_ENROLLMENT,
  MAX(iap.ENROLLMENT) AS MAX_ENROLLMENT
FROM `academic_terms` AS at
LEFT JOIN (
  -- derive IAP-like sessions from available course/section tables if an explicit iap_sessions table is not present.
  -- This subquery assumes IAP sessions are represented in drupal_course_catalog or course_catalog_subject_offered
  -- by a term duration or a flag mentioning IAP; adjust the filtering condition if your source differs.
  SELECT
    dcc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    dcc.SECTION_ID AS SESSION_ID,
    -- attempt to coerce fee and enrollment if present; else NULL
    NULL AS FEE_COLLECTED,
    NULL AS ENROLLMENT
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dcc
  WHERE dcc.TERM_DURATION LIKE '%IAP%' OR dcc.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ccso.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    ccso.SECTION_ID AS SESSION_ID,
    NULL AS FEE_COLLECTED,
    NULL AS ENROLLMENT
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
  WHERE ccso.TERM_DURATION LIKE '%IAP%' OR ccso.IS_OFFERED_IAP = 'Y'
) AS iap
  ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY at.TERM_CODE

rows.question: What is the name of the building, total number of subjects, total fee, and shortest and longest sessions for each physical IAP session location?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_sessions AS (
  -- The actual session data appears in course_catalog_subject_offered / drupal_course_catalog tables as SECTION-level fields.
  -- Use drupal_course_catalog which has SECTION_ID, MEET_PLACE, MEET_TIME and SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION / SO_TERM_CODE for term info.
  SELECT
    d.SECTION_ID AS SESSION_ID,
    d.MEET_PLACE AS LOCATION,
    -- split MEET_PLACE into building number and room if it follows "BUILDING ROOM" pattern; otherwise put whole string as building
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_PLACE, ' ', 1)) AS LOCATION_BUILDING_NUMBER,
    TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_PLACE, ' ', -1)) AS LOCATION_ROOM,
    d.MEET_TIME AS SESSION_TIME,
    d.SECTION_ID,
    d.SUBJECT_ID,
    d.FALL_INSTRUCTORS, -- placeholder if needed
    NULLIF(d.SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION, '') AS SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    NULL AS FEE,
    -- Attempt to parse start/end time from MEET_TIME if formatted like "hhmmAM-hhmmPM" or "hh:mmAM-hh:mmPM"
    -- Extract start and end substrings around '-' then normalize
    DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(
      TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_TIME, '-', 1)),
      '%h%i%p'
    ), '%h%i%p') AS SESSION_START_TIME,
    DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(
      TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_TIME, '-', -1)),
      '%h%i%p'
    ), '%h%i%p') AS SESSION_END_TIME,
    -- Calculate session length in minutes if both times parsed; otherwise NULL
    CASE
      WHEN STR_TO_DATE(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_TIME, '-', 1)), '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
       AND STR_TO_DATE(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_TIME, '-', -1)), '%h%i%p') IS NOT NULL
      THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(
        MINUTE,
        STR_TO_DATE(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_TIME, '-', 1)), '%h%i%p'),
        STR_TO_DATE(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(d.MEET_TIME, '-', -1)), '%h%i%p')
      )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS SESSION_LENGTH_MINUTES
  FROM drupal_course_catalog d
  WHERE
    -- filter to IAP sessions by term description or term code mentioning IAP / Independent Activities Period
    (d.SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%Independent Activities Period%' OR d.SO_TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE '%IAP%' OR d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE LIKE '%IAP%')
    -- ensure we have a meet place (physical location)
    AND d.MEET_PLACE IS NOT NULL
),
building_map AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    BUILDING_NAME,
    BUILDING_KEY
  FROM buildings
),
sessions_with_building AS (
  SELECT
    i.SESSION_ID,
    -- prefer mapping from building_map by number; if no mapping, fall back to LOCATION (full MEET_PLACE)
    COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, i.LOCATION) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    i.LOCATION_BUILDING_NUMBER,
    i.LOCATION_ROOM,
    i.SUBJECT_ID,
    IFNULL(i.FEE, 0) AS FEE,
    i.SESSION_LENGTH_MINUTES,
    i.SESSION_START_TIME,
    i.SESSION_END_TIME
  FROM iap_sessions i
  LEFT JOIN building_map b
    ON i.LOCATION_BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
)
SELECT
  s.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects,
  SUM(s.FEE) AS total_fee,
  MIN(s.SESSION_LENGTH_MINUTES) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  MAX(s.SESSION_LENGTH_MINUTES) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM sessions_with_building s
GROUP BY s.BUILDING_NAME
ORDER BY s.BUILDING_NAME

rows.question: What is total number of subjects, the total fee, and the shortest and longest sessions, for all virtual IAP sessions?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(sd.`SUBJECT_ID`, sd_all.`SUBJECT_ID`)) AS total_subjects,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(sd.`FEE`, sd_all.`FEE`)), 0) AS total_fee,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN t.end_minutes >= t.start_minutes THEN t.end_minutes - t.start_minutes
      ELSE t.end_minutes + 24*60 - t.start_minutes
    END
  ) AS shortest_session_minutes,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN t.end_minutes >= t.start_minutes THEN t.end_minutes - t.start_minutes
      ELSE t.end_minutes + 24*60 - t.start_minutes
    END
  ) AS longest_session_minutes
FROM (
  -- source sessions with non-empty start/end times and virtual/online location
  SELECT
    s.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    s.`SESSION_LOCATION`,
    s.`SESSION_START_TIME`,
    s.`SESSION_END_TIME`
  FROM iap_subject_session s
  WHERE NOT (
    (s.`SESSION_START_TIME` IS NULL OR s.`SESSION_START_TIME` = '')
    AND
    (s.`SESSION_END_TIME` IS NULL OR s.`SESSION_END_TIME` = '')
  )
    AND s.`SESSION_LOCATION` IS NOT NULL
    AND (LOWER(s.`SESSION_LOCATION`) LIKE '%virtual%' OR LOWER(s.`SESSION_LOCATION`) LIKE '%online%')
) raw
JOIN (
  -- compute numeric minutes from times like "8:30AM" or "0830PM" or "8AM"
  SELECT
    r.`IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY`,
    r.`SESSION_LOCATION`,
    r.`SESSION_START_TIME`,
    r.`SESSION_END_TIME`,
    -- start_minutes
    (
      (CASE
         WHEN RIGHT(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')), 2) = 'AM'
           THEN CASE
                  WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) = 12
                    THEN 0
                  ELSE CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) * 60
               END
         WHEN RIGHT(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')), 2) = 'PM'
           THEN CASE
                  WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) = 12
                    THEN 12 * 60
                  ELSE (CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) + 12) * 60
               END
         ELSE NULL
       END)
      +
      CAST(SUBSTRING(
        UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')),
        GREATEST(CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', ''))) - 1, 0),
        2
      ) AS UNSIGNED)
    ) AS start_minutes,
    -- end_minutes
    (
      (CASE
         WHEN RIGHT(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')), 2) = 'AM'
           THEN CASE
                  WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) = 12
                    THEN 0
                  ELSE CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) * 60
               END
         WHEN RIGHT(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')), 2) = 'PM'
           THEN CASE
                  WHEN CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) = 12
                    THEN 12 * 60
                  ELSE (CAST(SUBSTRING(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')), 1,
                       CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', ''))) - 2) AS UNSIGNED) + 12) * 60
               END
         ELSE NULL
       END)
      +
      CAST(SUBSTRING(
        UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')),
        GREATEST(CHAR_LENGTH(UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', ''))) - 1, 0),
        2
      ) AS UNSIGNED)
    ) AS end_minutes
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM iap_subject_session
  ) r
  WHERE NOT (
    (r.`SESSION_START_TIME` IS NULL OR r.`SESSION_START_TIME` = '')
    AND
    (r.`SESSION_END_TIME` IS NULL OR r.`SESSION_END_TIME` = '')
  )
    AND r.`SESSION_LOCATION` IS NOT NULL
    AND (LOWER(r.`SESSION_LOCATION`) LIKE '%virtual%' OR LOWER(r.`SESSION_LOCATION`) LIKE '%online%')
    AND UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_START_TIME, ':', '')) REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,4}(AM|PM)$'
    AND UPPER(REPLACE(r.SESSION_END_TIME, ':', '')) REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,4}(AM|PM)$'
) t ON raw.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = t.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
-- join details table: use iap_subject_session_detail_all if primary doesn't exist; prefer sd then sd_all
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM iap_subject_session_detail_all) sd_all
  ON t.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sd_all.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM iap_subject_session_detail) sd
  ON t.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = sd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
WHERE
  (sd.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL OR sd_all.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL)

rows.question: What is the school code, school name, full name of the department, course level, total number of courses, and total number of degree-granting courses for each school code, department, and course level?

SELECT
  d.SCHOOL_CODE AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  d.SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  c.COURSE_LEVEL AS COURSE_LEVEL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS TOTAL_COURSES,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN c.COURSE END) AS TOTAL_DEGREE_GRANTING_COURSES

  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ASC,

rows.question: What are the different schools and departments that offer SIS courses? List their school code, school name, department code, department name, the total number of phone numbers, and the most common course level.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  s.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME   AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE   AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME   AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.OFFICE_PHONE) AS TOTAL_PHONE_NUMBERS,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT cl.GRADE_TYPE
    FROM (
      SELECT c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c
      WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
        AND (c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR IS NULL OR c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR <> 'N')
      GROUP BY c.GRADE_TYPE
      ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.GRADE_TYPE
      LIMIT 1
    ) cl
  ), 'U') AS MOST_COMMON_COURSE_LEVEL
FROM employee_directory s
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered d
  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN employee_directory p
  ON p.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered c2
  WHERE c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
)
GROUP BY
  s.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER,
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: What is the school code, school name, DLC key, the graduate level, total number of SIS subjects, the minimum and maximum course numbers, and the total number of departments offering subjects for each school?
rows.pred_sql:
-- Revised query to meet the specification: for each school (by SCHOOL_CODE) compute required aggregates.
-- Uses cis_course_catalog as the primary subject table (permitted subject tables in schema).
-- Maps subjects to a school by preferring explicit SCHOOL_CODE if present (here derived from DEPARTMENT_CODE prefix),
-- otherwise uses MASTER_SUBJECT_ID as a fallback key for grouping. Excludes rows with no school association.
WITH subjects AS (
  SELECT
    -- derive a SCHOOL_CODE: prefer an explicit SCHOOL_CODE column if it existed.
    -- In available tables we have DEPARTMENT_CODE formatted like "SCHOOL-..." so extract prefix as SCHOOL_CODE.
    NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(DEPARTMENT_CODE, '-', 1)), '') AS SCHOOL_CODE,
    -- keep SCHOOL_NAME where available; use SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES as a surrogate if no explicit name column exists
    NULLIF(TRIM(SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES), '') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- DLC key: prefer department-level DLC_KEY if present; cis_course_catalog doesn't have DLC_KEY, carry MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
    NULLIF(TRIM(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID), '') AS DLC_KEY,
    -- graduate level: try GRADUATE_LEVEL or GRADAUTE_LEVEL if present (cis_course_catalog doesn't have them in DDL,
    -- but keep both columns in case other subject tables are unioned in future). Use COALESCE per spec.
    NULLIF(TRIM(NULL), '') AS GRADUATE_LEVEL, -- placeholder NULL because cis_course_catalog has no graduate columns
    -- Subject identifiers for counting distinct SIS subjects: use SUBJECT_ID if present, else SUBJECT_CODE+SUBJECT_NUMBER
    NULLIF(TRIM(SUBJECT_ID), '') AS SUBJECT_ID,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS('-', SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER)), '') AS COURSE_KEY,
    NULLIF(TRIM(SUBJECT_NUMBER), '') AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    NULLIF(TRIM(DEPARTMENT_CODE), '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE
  FROM cis_course_catalog
),
-- Drop rows that do not map to any school per the instruction (ignore rows with NULL school code).
subjects_with_school AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM subjects
  WHERE SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
-- Aggregate per school: count distinct SIS subjects, min/max course_number lexicographically, count distinct departments
school_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    SCHOOL_CODE,
    -- choose a SCHOOL_NAME (may be NULL)
    MAX(SCHOOL_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- DLC_KEY: per spec prefer sis_department.DLC_KEY if available; not present in schema, so use DLC_KEY carried from subjects
    MAX(DLC_KEY) AS DLC_KEY,
    -- GRADUATE_LEVEL: spec says prefer GRADUATE_LEVEL or GRADAUTE_LEVEL; we only have placeholder NULL above, keep COALESCE logic
    MAX(GRADUATE_LEVEL) AS GRADUATE_LEVEL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_KEY)) AS TOTAL_SIS_SUBJECTS,
    MIN(COURSE_NUMBER) AS MIN_COURSE_NUMBER,
    MAX(COURSE_NUMBER) AS MAX_COURSE_NUMBER,
    COUNT(DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS TOTAL_DEPARTMENTS_OFFERING_SUBJECTS
  FROM subjects_with_school
  GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE
)
SELECT
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  DLC_KEY,
  GRADUATE_LEVEL,
  TOTAL_SIS_SUBJECTS,
  MIN_COURSE_NUMBER,
  MAX_COURSE_NUMBER,
  TOTAL_DEPARTMENTS_OFFERING_SUBJECTS
FROM school_aggregates
ORDER BY SCHOOL_CODE ASC

rows.question: What is the building component, name of the building, square footage for all rooms, total number of floors, total number of rooms, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, and total number of supervisees for each building component?

WITH fac_building_base AS (
  SELECT
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    `DATE_BUILT` AS DATE_BUILT,
    `NUM_OF_ROOMS` AS NUM_OF_ROOMS,
    `EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    `ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS COST_COLLECTOR_KEY
  FROM `fac_building`
),
space_detail_room_level AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(sd.BUILDING_COMPONENT, ''), fb.BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_COMPONENT,
    COALESCE(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, 0) AS ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    CONCAT(
      COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(sd.ROOM_NUMBER, '') <> '' THEN '-'
        ELSE ''
      END,
      COALESCE(sd.ROOM_NUMBER, '')
    ) AS BUILDING_ROOM,
    sd.ROOM_NUMBER AS ROOM_NUMBER,
    sd.FLOOR_KEY AS FLOOR_KEY,
    sd.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY AS SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.BUILDING_NUMBER AS BUILDING_NUMBER
  FROM space_detail sd
  LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
    ON sd.BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
),
space_supervisor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    DEPT_NAMES,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS distinct_supervisors,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES,0)) AS sum_supervisees
  FROM space_supervisor_usage
  GROUP BY DEPT_NAMES
)
SELECT
  s.BUILDING_COMPONENT AS BUILDING_COMPONENT,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY s.BUILDING_NAME SEPARATOR '; ') AS BUILDING_NAME,
  SUM(s.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS TOTAL_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.FLOOR_KEY) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_FLOORS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.BUILDING_ROOM, CONCAT(s.BUILDING_KEY,'|',s.ROOM_NUMBER))) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_ROOMS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY, fcr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY)) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_FACILITY_ORGANIZATIONS,
  SUM(COALESCE(ssa.distinct_supervisors,0)) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_SUPERVISORS,
  SUM(COALESCE(ssa.sum_supervisees,0)) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_SUPERVISEES
FROM space_detail_room_level s
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  ON (
       (fr.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fr.BUILDING_KEY = s.BUILDING_KEY AND fr.ROOM_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM_NUMBER = s.ROOM_NUMBER)
    OR (fr.BUILDING_ROOM IS NULL AND fr.ROOM_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND CONCAT(COALESCE(s.BUILDING_NUMBER,''), '-', COALESCE(s.ROOM_NUMBER,'')) = CONCAT(COALESCE(fr.BUILDING_NUMBER,''), '-', COALESCE(fr.ROOM_NUMBER,'')))
    OR (fr.BUILDING_ROOM IS NOT NULL AND fr.BUILDING_ROOM = s.BUILDING_ROOM)
     )
LEFT JOIN fclt_rooms fcr
  ON (fcr.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY OR (fcr.BUILDING_KEY = s.BUILDING_KEY AND fcr.ROOM_NUMBER = s.ROOM_NUMBER))
LEFT JOIN fac_building_base fb2
  ON fb2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = COALESCE(fcr.BUILDING_KEY, s.BUILDING_KEY)
LEFT JOIN space_supervisor_agg ssa
  ON ssa.DEPT_NAMES = COALESCE(fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fcr.ORGANIZATION_NAME)
WHERE s.BUILDING_COMPONENT IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.BUILDING_COMPONENT) <> ''
GROUP BY s.BUILDING_COMPONENT
ORDER BY s.BUILDING_COMPONENT

rows.question: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each building?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  d.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS DLC_KEY,
  d.`BUILDING_NAME` AS DLC_NAME,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.`NUM_OF_ROOMS`), 0) AS TOTAL_NUM_FLOORS,
  COALESCE(SUM(d.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`), 0) AS TOTAL_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  -- count distinct facility organizations: using FAC_BUILDING_KEY as the org identifier proxy
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`), 0) AS TOTAL_FACILITY_ORGS,
  -- supervisor / supervisee info not available in the provided schema, return 0
  0 AS TOTAL_SUPERVISORS,
  0 AS TOTAL_SUPERVISEES,
  -- sum building heights: convert BUILDING_HEIGHT to numeric when possible, treat non-numeric as 0
  COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN d.`BUILDING_HEIGHT` REGEXP '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(d.`BUILDING_HEIGHT` AS DECIMAL(18,2))
      ELSE 0
    END
  ), 0) AS TOTAL_BUILDING_HEIGHT
FROM `fac_building` d
LEFT JOIN `fac_building_address` fba
  ON fba.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = d.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
GROUP BY d.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, d.`BUILDING_NAME`

rows.question: What are the details of courses offered in the current academic term, including the academic year, term code, hgn code, the total number of types of courses, the average number of units, the department name, the name and email address of the person in charge?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH current_academic_term AS (
  SELECT
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    `TERM_START_DATE`,
    `TERM_END_DATE`,
    `ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY`
  FROM `academic_terms`
  WHERE `IS_CURRENT_TERM` = 'Y'
     OR `IS_CURRENT_TERM` = '1'
     OR LOWER(`IS_CURRENT_TERM`) = 'true'
     OR `IS_CURRENT_TERM` = 'T'
     OR `TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR` = 'CURRENT'
     OR `TERM_STATUS` = 'CURRENT'
)
SELECT
  cat.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  cat.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(so.SUBJECT_ID, so.SUBJECT_CODE, so.PRINT_SUBJECT_ID, so.SECTION_ID)) AS TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_COURSE_TYPES,
  -- average of TOTAL_UNITS excluding NULLs; treat 0 as NULL per original AVG(NULLIF(...,0))
  AVG(NULLIF(so.TOTAL_UNITS, 0)) AS AVERAGE_UNITS,
  so.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_PERSON_NAME,
  COALESCE(ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ded.EMAIL_ADDRESS, opd.EMAIL_ADDRESS) AS RESPONSIBLE_PERSON_EMAIL
FROM current_academic_term AS cat
JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS so
  ON so.TERM_CODE = cat.TERM_CODE
-- prefer master sections to avoid duplicate section-level rows when that flag exists; include rows when flag is null
  AND (so.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' OR so.IS_MASTER_SECTION IS NULL)
LEFT JOIN employee_directory AS ed
  ON ed.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN opa_person_current AS opd
  ON opd.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory AS ded
  ON ded.MIT_ID = so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID
WHERE cat.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND cat.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
  AND so.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  cat.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  cat.TERM_CODE,
  so.HGN_CODE,
  so.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  COALESCE(so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
ORDER BY
  so.DEPARTMENT_NAME ASC,
  so.HGN_CODE ASC

rows.question: Retrieve information about the IAP subjects, including their titles, categories, session titles, session start time, session end time, sponsor names, and total number of sessions.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH iap_subject_detail_core AS (
  SELECT
    iap.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
    iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    iap.TERM_CODE,
    iap.MAX_ENROLLMENT,
    CASE
      WHEN iap.IS_CANCELLED IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(iap.IS_CANCELLED)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1') THEN 'Y'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(iap.IS_CANCELLED)) IN ('N','NO','FALSE','0') THEN 'N'
      ELSE iap.IS_CANCELLED
    END AS IS_CANCELLED,
    CASE
      WHEN iap.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(iap.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1') THEN 'Y'
          WHEN UPPER(TRIM(iap.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION)) IN ('N','NO','FALSE','0') THEN 'N'
          ELSE iap.IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION
        END
      WHEN iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY IS NOT NULL AND iap.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY LIKE '%-%' THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_MULTIPLE_SESSION
  FROM iap_subject_detail iap
)
SELECT
  d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY,
  d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS ACTIVITY_TITLE,
  c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME,
  s.SESSION_TITLE,
  s.SESSION_START_TIME,
  s.SESSION_END_TIME,
  sp.SPONSOR_NAME,
  COUNT(s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) AS TOTAL_SESSIONS
FROM iap_subject_detail_core d
JOIN iap_subject_category c
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_session s
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_sponsor sp
  ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = sp.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
WHERE d.ACTIVITY_TITLE IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) <> ''
  AND NOT (
        (s.SESSION_TITLE IS NULL OR TRIM(s.SESSION_TITLE) = '')
    AND (s.SESSION_START_TIME IS NULL OR TRIM(s.SESSION_START_TIME) = '')
    AND (s.SESSION_END_TIME IS NULL OR TRIM(s.SESSION_END_TIME) = '')
  )
ORDER BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, s.SESSION_SEQUENCE ASC

rows.question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, and the total number of courses per department.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  dsc.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  COALESCE(dsc.SUBJECT_TITLE, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
  -- use course-level graduate flag if available in cis_course_catalog/drupal fields or best-effort from title
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(dcd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, dsc.GRADUATE_LEVEL, '') <> '' THEN COALESCE(dcd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, dsc.GRADUATE_LEVEL)
    WHEN COALESCE(dsc.SUBJECT_TITLE, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) REGEXP '(?i)(GRADUATE|\\bGR\\b|\\bGRAD\\b)' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS GRADUATE_LEVEL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(dsc.SUBJECT_CODE, ' ', COALESCE(dsc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ''))) AS TOTAL_COURSES
FROM (
  -- canonical subject/course rows from available catalogs
  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    SECTION_ID,
    NULL AS GRADUATE_LEVEL
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    SECTION_ID,
    NULL AS GRADUATE_LEVEL
  FROM drupal_course_catalog
  WHERE SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE <> ''

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    SUBJECT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS SECTION_ID,
    NULL AS GRADUATE_LEVEL
  FROM cis_course_catalog
  WHERE SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_CODE <> ''
) AS dsc
LEFT JOIN (
  -- department name lookup to fill missing department names
  SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    UNION
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM drupal_course_catalog
    UNION
    SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM cis_course_catalog
  ) t
) dc
  ON dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  -- try to pull graduate level from sis-style course description table if COURSE stored as "SUBJECT_CODE COURSE_NUMBER"
  SELECT
    COURSE,
    GRADUATE_LEVEL
  FROM sis_course_description
) dcd
  ON dcd.COURSE = CONCAT(dsc.SUBJECT_CODE, ' ', COALESCE(dsc.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ''))
WHERE dsc.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME),
  dsc.SUBJECT_CODE,
  COALESCE(dsc.SUBJECT_TITLE, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME),
  -- include derived graduate columns in group by so results are deterministic
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(dcd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, dsc.GRADUATE_LEVEL, '') <> '' THEN COALESCE(dcd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, dsc.GRADUATE_LEVEL)
    WHEN COALESCE(dsc.SUBJECT_TITLE, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) REGEXP '(?i)(GRADUATE|\\bGR\\b|\\bGRAD\\b)' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(dsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) ASC

rows.question: What is the author, school name, material status, total record counts, and total number of types of courses for each author and school?

WITH tip_subject_offered_course_and_school AS (
  SELECT
    tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    tso.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME` AS `OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`,
    -- Prefer MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER when present (non-null/non-empty), otherwise COURSE_NUMBER
    CASE
      WHEN tso.`MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tso.`MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER`) <> '' THEN tso.`MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER`
      ELSE tso.`COURSE_NUMBER`
    END AS `MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER`,
    tso.`COURSE_NUMBER` AS `COURSE_NUMBER`
  FROM tip_subject_offered AS tso
)
SELECT
  m.AUTHOR AS AUTHOR,
  so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- return distinct material statuses as a semicolon-separated list (one row per author+school)
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS ORDER BY ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS SEPARATOR '; ') AS MATERIAL_STATUSES,
  SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS TOTAL_RECORD_COUNT,
  -- number of distinct material statuses for this author+school
  COUNT(DISTINCT ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS) AS NUM_DISTINCT_MATERIAL_STATUSES,
  -- number of distinct course identifiers: prefer MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER (from CTE) otherwise COURSE_NUMBER
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(so.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER, so.COURSE_NUMBER)) AS NUM_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES
FROM tip_detail d
JOIN tip_material m
  ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN tip_material_status ms
  ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
JOIN tip_subject_offered_course_and_school so
  ON d.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = so.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WHERE m.AUTHOR IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(m.AUTHOR) <> ''
GROUP BY
  m.AUTHOR,
  so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME
ORDER BY
  m.AUTHOR ASC,
  so.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ASC

rows.question: What is the course number, subject title, material status, the total, min, and max new shelf price, the total, min, and max used shelf price, total number of schools and the total number of materials for each TIP subject and material status?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  c.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS course_number,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE AS subject_title,
  -- prefer STATUS_CHANGE, fall back to SO_CLUSTER_TYPE for material status
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(dc.STATUS_CHANGE), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE), '')) AS material_status,
  -- price columns don't exist in the provided DDL, return NULLs for price aggregates
  SUM(NULL) AS total_new_shelf_price,
  MIN(NULL) AS min_new_shelf_price,
  MAX(NULL) AS max_new_shelf_price,
  SUM(NULL) AS total_used_shelf_price,
  MIN(NULL) AS min_used_shelf_price,
  MAX(NULL) AS max_used_shelf_price,
  -- no SCHOOL_ID in schema; use distinct SO_TERM_CODE as a proxy for distinct "schools" if available,
  -- otherwise count distinct RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID as another possible proxy.
  -- Here we count distinct SO_TERM_CODE when present, else distinct RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  -- else distinct DEPARTMENT_CODE as final fallback.
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(dc.SO_TERM_CODE), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dc.DEPARTMENT_CODE), ''))) AS total_schools,
  COUNT(*) AS total_materials
FROM cis_course_catalog c
JOIN drupal_course_catalog dc
  ON dc.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE (
    (dc.STATUS_CHANGE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(dc.STATUS_CHANGE) LIKE '%tip%')
    OR (dc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(dc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE) LIKE '%tip%')
)
GROUP BY
  c.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
  c.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(dc.STATUS_CHANGE), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(dc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE), ''))

rows.question: What is material status, the total number of materials, the total number of subjects, the total number of schools, and the most recent publication year for each material status?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS material_status,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`) AS total_materials,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tsl.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS total_subjects,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tsl.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`) AS total_schools,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN m.`YEAR` IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN TRIM(m.`YEAR`) = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN m.`YEAR` REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(m.`YEAR` AS UNSIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS most_recent_publication_year
FROM `tip_material_status` AS ms
LEFT JOIN `tip_material` AS m
  ON (
       (ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` IS NOT NULL AND m.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`)
       OR (ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` IS NOT NULL AND m.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` = ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS`)
     )
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    tdm.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
    tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
    tso.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    tso.`OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME`
  FROM `tip_detail` AS tdm
  JOIN `tip_subject_offered` AS tso
    ON tdm.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
) AS tsl
  ON tsl.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY` = m.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`
GROUP BY ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`, ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS`
ORDER BY ms.`TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS`

rows.question: What is the term description, whether the term is current or not, total number of types of TIP subjects offered and materials needed, the minimum and maximum number of enrolled students, the total number of schools offering subjects, and the total number of records for each term code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH academic_terms_minimal AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
    at.IS_CURRENT_TERM AS IS_CURRENT_TERM
  FROM academic_terms AS at
  GROUP BY at.TERM_CODE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.IS_CURRENT_TERM
),
-- keep joinable keys from source tables per instructions
tip_subject_material_link AS (
  SELECT
    td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tso.TERM_CODE,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM tip_detail td
  JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
    ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
),
tip_detail_rows AS (
  SELECT
    tsl.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY,
    tsl.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
    tsl.TERM_CODE,
    tsl.SUBJECT_ID
  FROM tip_subject_material_link AS tsl
)
SELECT
  t.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
  atm.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  atm.IS_CURRENT_TERM AS IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  COALESCE(tso.tip_subject_count, 0) AS TIP_SUBJECT_COUNT,
  COALESCE(tdr.tip_material_count, 0) AS TIP_MATERIAL_COUNT,
  tso.min_enrolled AS MIN_ENROLLED,
  tso.max_enrolled AS MAX_ENROLLED,
  COALESCE(tso.school_count, 0) AS SCHOOL_COUNT,
  COALESCE(tso.tso_rows, 0) + COALESCE(tdr.td_rows, 0) AS TOTAL_TIP_RECORDS
FROM (
  -- union of all term codes from academic terms, subject_offered, and tip_detail_rows
  SELECT TERM_CODE FROM academic_terms_minimal
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE FROM tip_subject_offered
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT TERM_CODE FROM tip_detail_rows
) AS t
LEFT JOIN academic_terms_minimal AS atm
  ON t.TERM_CODE = atm.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (

rows.question: List all buildings with their names, building numbers, building height, street address, city, state, HR department name, assignable square footage, total and average square footage, ordered in descending order of assignable, total, and average square footage.

SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT,
  addr.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  addr.CITY,
  addr.STATE_PROVINCE AS STATE,
  fb.COST_CENTER_CODE AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  b.BLDG_ASSIGNABLE_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS ASSIGNABLE_SQ_FT,
  fb.EXT_GROSS_AREA AS TOTAL_SQ_FT,

rows.question: For the 2023 Fall term, what are the unique term descriptions, subject titles along with their prerequisites, total number of types of subjects per term code, instructor of this course, and the number of types of courses ever taught by the instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_of_interest AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`
  FROM `academic_terms`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` = '2023FA'
  LIMIT 1
),
term_courses AS (
  SELECT
    ccso.`TERM_CODE`,
    COALESCE(cc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, dc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, ccso.`SUBJECT_TITLE`) AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    COALESCE(cc.`PREREQUISITES`, dc.`PREREQUISITES`, ccso.`PREREQUISITES`) AS `PREREQUISITES`,
    COALESCE(ccso.`SECTION_ID`, dc.`SECTION_ID`) AS `SECTION_ID`,
    COALESCE(ccso.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`, dc.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`) AS `INSTRUCTOR`,
    COALESCE(cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, dc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, ccso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`) AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    COALESCE(cc.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`, dc.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`, ccso.`HASS_ATTRIBUTE`) AS `HASS_ATTRIBUTE`,
    COALESCE(cc.`HGN_CODE`, dc.`HGN_CODE`, ccso.`HGN_CODE`) AS `HGN_CODE`,
    COALESCE(cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, dc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, ccso.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    COALESCE(cc.`SUBJECT_ID`, dc.`SUBJECT_ID`, ccso.`SUBJECT_ID`) AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    COALESCE(cc.`SUBJECT_CODE`, dc.`SUBJECT_CODE`, ccso.`SUBJECT_CODE`) AS `SUBJECT_CODE`
  FROM term_of_interest t
  JOIN `course_catalog_subject_offered` ccso ON ccso.`TERM_CODE` = t.`TERM_CODE`
  LEFT JOIN `cis_course_catalog` cc ON cc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = t.`TERM_CODE` AND cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = ccso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog` dc ON dc.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` = t.`TERM_CODE` AND dc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = ccso.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
  WHERE ccso.`TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
),
subject_types_per_term AS (
  SELECT
    `TERM_CODE`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_CODE`)) AS `UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TYPES`
  FROM term_courses
  GROUP BY `TERM_CODE`
),
-- helper to split comma lists of instructors from cis_course_catalog using numbers table
numbers AS (
  SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
instructor_history AS (
  SELECT
    s.`INSTRUCTOR`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(s.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, s.`SUBJECT_ID`, s.`SUBJECT_CODE`)) AS `EVERY_COURSE_TYPES_TAUGHT`
  FROM (
    SELECT `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS `INSTRUCTOR`, `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_CODE`
    FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
    WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` != ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS `INSTRUCTOR`, `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_CODE`
    FROM `drupal_course_catalog`
    WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` != ''

    UNION ALL

    -- split FALL_INSTRUCTORS by comma using substring_index and a numbers table
    SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(
             SUBSTRING_INDEX(
               SUBSTRING_INDEX(`FALL_INSTRUCTORS`, ',', n.n),
               ',', -1
             )
           ), '') AS `INSTRUCTOR`,
           `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_CODE`
    FROM `cis_course_catalog`
    JOIN numbers n ON (CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(`FALL_INSTRUCTORS`, '')) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(IFNULL(`FALL_INSTRUCTORS`, ''), ',', ''))) >= n.n-1
    WHERE `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` IS NOT NULL AND `FALL_INSTRUCTORS` != ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(
             SUBSTRING_INDEX(
               SUBSTRING_INDEX(`SPRING_INSTRUCTORS`, ',', n.n),
               ',', -1
             )
           ), '') AS `INSTRUCTOR`,
           `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_CODE`
    FROM `cis_course_catalog`
    JOIN numbers n ON (CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(`SPRING_INSTRUCTORS`, '')) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(IFNULL(`SPRING_INSTRUCTORS`, ''), ',', ''))) >= n.n-1
    WHERE `SPRING_INSTRUCTORS` IS NOT NULL AND `SPRING_INSTRUCTORS` != ''
  ) s
  WHERE s.`INSTRUCTOR` IS NOT NULL AND s.`INSTRUCTOR` != ''
  GROUP BY s.`INSTRUCTOR`
)
SELECT
  tc.`TERM_CODE`,
  -- unique term descriptions for the term (from either table)
  (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) SEPARATOR '; ')
    FROM `academic_terms` at
    LEFT JOIN `academic_terms_all` ata ON ata.`TERM_CODE` = at.`TERM_CODE`
    WHERE at.`TERM_CODE` = tc.`TERM_CODE` OR ata.`TERM_CODE` = tc.`TERM_CODE`
  ) AS `TERM_DESCRIPTIONS`,
  tc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
  tc.`PREREQUISITES`,
  COALESCE(st.`UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TYPES`, 0) AS `TOTAL_UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TYPES_IN_TERM`,
  tc.`INSTRUCTOR`,
  COALESCE(ih.`EVERY_COURSE_TYPES_TAUGHT`, 0) AS `INSTRUCTOR_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES_EVER_TAUGHT`
FROM term_courses tc
LEFT JOIN subject_types_per_term st ON st.`TERM_CODE` = tc.`TERM_CODE`
LEFT JOIN instructor_history ih ON ih.`INSTRUCTOR` = tc.`INSTRUCTOR`
GROUP BY
  tc.`TERM_CODE`,
  tc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`,
  tc.`PREREQUISITES`,
  tc.`INSTRUCTOR`,
  st.`UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TYPES`,
  ih.`EVERY_COURSE_TYPES_TAUGHT`
ORDER BY tc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`

rows.question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the assignable floor area and building.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  r.FAC_BUILDING_ROOM_KEY AS ROOM_KEY,
  r.ROOM_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  r.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  r.FLOOR_NUMBER,
  COALESCE(o.FULL_NAME, r.OCCUPANT_NAME) AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  r.ROOM_AREA,
  fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  -- percentage of room area over the assignable floor area (use floor assignable if available else building assignable)
  CASE
    WHEN fa.ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL AND fa.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * r.ROOM_AREA / fa.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 4)
    WHEN fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL AND fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * r.ROOM_AREA / fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS PCT_OF_ASSIGNABLE_FLOOR_AREA,
  -- percentage of room area over the building assignable area
  CASE
    WHEN fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL AND fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0
      THEN ROUND(100.0 * r.ROOM_AREA / fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS PCT_OF_BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
FROM fac_building_room r
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON r.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN buildings b
  ON r.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
-- floor-level assignable area: use fac_building_address rows that may represent floor summaries (matching building_number + floor_number)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_NUMBER, FLOOR_NUMBER, ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  FROM fac_building_address
  WHERE ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL
) fa
  ON r.BUILDING_NUMBER = fa.BUILDING_NUMBER
  AND r.FLOOR_NUMBER = fa.FLOOR_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory o
  ON r.OCCUPANT_MIT_ID = o.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN employee_directory d
  ON r.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = d.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER

rows.question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the floor area and building.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH fac_building_summary AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_NAME,
    fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  FROM fac_building fb
),
-- ensure floor assignable area is available per floor key
fac_floor_base AS (
  SELECT
    ff.FLOOR_KEY,
    ff.FLOOR,
    ff.ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  FROM fac_floor ff
)
SELECT
  r.ROOM_FULL_NAME AS ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(r.FLOOR, f.FLOOR) AS FLOOR,
  r.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  r.DEPT_CODE AS DEPT_CODE,
  CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ROOM_AREA,
  CAST(f.FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  CAST(b.BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  CASE
    WHEN f.FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NULL OR CAST(f.FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND( (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / CAST(f.FLOOR_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) * 100, 2)
  END AS PCT_OF_FLOOR,
  CASE
    WHEN b.BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NULL OR CAST(b.BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND( (CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / CAST(b.BUILDING_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6))) * 100, 2)
  END AS PCT_OF_BUILDING
FROM fac_rooms r
JOIN fac_building_summary b
  ON r.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
JOIN fac_floor_base f
  ON r.FLOOR_KEY = f.FLOOR_KEY
WHERE r.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND r.FLOOR_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND r.AREA IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(r.AREA AS DECIMAL(18,6)) > 0
ORDER BY
  b.BUILDING_NAME ASC,
  -- numeric floor ordering when possible: extract leading numeric part, fallback to text
  (CASE
     WHEN COALESCE(r.FLOOR, f.FLOOR) REGEXP '^[0-9]+' THEN CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(COALESCE(r.FLOOR, f.FLOOR), '^[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED)
     ELSE NULL
   END) ASC,
  COALESCE(r.FLOOR, f.FLOOR) ASC,
  COALESCE(r.ROOM_FULL_NAME, '') ASC

rows.question: What are the academic year, and instructors names for courses offered in the academic year 2022, along with the total number of types of courses per instructor?
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  src.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  inst.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT_WS('::', src.SUBJECT_CODE, src.SUBJECT_NUMBER, IFNULL(src.SECTION_ID,''))) AS TOTAL_COURSE_TYPES
FROM (
  SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SECTION_ID
  FROM drupal_course_catalog
  WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022-2023' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR LIKE '2022%'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SECTION_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022-2023' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR LIKE '2022%'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS SECTION_ID
  FROM cis_course_catalog
  WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022-2023' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR LIKE '2022%'
) AS src
JOIN (
  -- split comma-separated instructor lists into rows up to 10 items
  SELECT src_row_id, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SECTION_ID,
         TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(instructors_concat, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT
      @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS src_row_id,
      s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s.SECTION_ID,
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(s.FALL_INSTRUCTORS,''),NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN s.FALL_INSTRUCTORS
        WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS,''),NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN s.SPRING_INSTRUCTORS
        ELSE NULL
      END AS instructors_concat
    FROM (
      SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SECTION_ID
        FROM drupal_course_catalog
        WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022-2023' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR LIKE '2022%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SECTION_ID
        FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
        WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022-2023' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR LIKE '2022%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, FALL_INSTRUCTORS, SPRING_INSTRUCTORS, IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, NULL AS SECTION_ID
        FROM cis_course_catalog
        WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2022-2023' OR ACADEMIC_YEAR LIKE '2022%'
      ) x
    ) s
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := 0) vars_init
  ) base
  JOIN (
    SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  ) n ON base.instructors_concat IS NOT NULL
  WHERE TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(base.instructors_concat, ',', n.n), ',', -1)) <> ''
) inst ON inst.ACADEMIC_YEAR = src.ACADEMIC_YEAR
       AND ( (inst.SUBJECT_CODE = src.SUBJECT_CODE OR (inst.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND src.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL))
             AND (inst.SUBJECT_NUMBER = src.SUBJECT_NUMBER OR (inst.SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL AND src.SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NULL))
             AND ( (inst.SECTION_ID = src.SECTION_ID) OR (inst.SECTION_ID IS NULL AND src.SECTION_ID IS NULL) )
           )
GROUP BY src.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inst.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
ORDER BY src.ACADEMIC_YEAR, TOTAL_COURSE_TYPES DESC

rows.question: What are the building names, department names, organizations, their highest and lowest floor number, along with the total number of rooms per each building key?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH building_core AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, '')) AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_NAME, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ''), NULLIF(fb.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_NAME, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG
  FROM fac_building fb
  LEFT JOIN buildings b
    ON (
         (fb.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER)
         OR (fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY <> '' AND b.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_KEY <> '' AND fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b.BUILDING_KEY)
       )
  UNION
  SELECT
    b2.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    NULLIF(b2.BUILDING_NUMBER, '') AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    NULLIF(b2.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS BUILDING_NAME,
    NULLIF(b2.BUILDING_NAME, '') AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG
  FROM buildings b2
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fac_building fb2
    WHERE (
            (fb2.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND fb2.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND b2.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND b2.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND fb2.BUILDING_NUMBER = b2.BUILDING_NUMBER)
         OR (fb2.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fb2.FAC_BUILDING_KEY <> '' AND b2.BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND b2.BUILDING_KEY <> '' AND fb2.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = b2.BUILDING_KEY)
          )
  )
),
-- Aggregate rooms: schema does not include fac_rooms in provided fragment, but course_catalog_subject_offered and drupal tables include SECTION-related fields.
-- Use fac_building.NUM_OF_ROOMS when available, and fall back to counting fac_floor entries as proxy for rooms if needed.
rooms_agg AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(COALESCE(fb.NUM_OF_ROOMS, 0)) AS TOTAL_ROOMS,
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAMES,
    NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAMES
  FROM fac_building fb
  GROUP BY fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
),
-- If fac_floor exists with FLOOR column (schema fragment showed fac_building only). We'll try to use fac_building DATE_BUILT etc.
-- But original query referenced fac_floor and fac_rooms which aren't in full schema snippet. Handle floor extraction defensively:
floor_raw AS (
  SELECT
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS floor -- placeholder since fac_floor not in provided schema excerpt
  FROM fac_building fb
  WHERE fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL
),
floor_extracted AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    floor,
    '' AS numeric_floor
  FROM floor_raw
),
floor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    fe.BUILDING_KEY,
    NULL AS HIGHEST_FLOOR,
    NULL AS LOWEST_FLOOR
  FROM floor_extracted fe
  GROUP BY fe.BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  bc.BUILDING_KEY,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(bc.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(bc.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  ra.DEPARTMENT_NAMES,
  ra.ORGANIZATION_NAMES,
  fa.HIGHEST_FLOOR,
  fa.LOWEST_FLOOR,
  COALESCE(ra.TOTAL_ROOMS, 0) AS TOTAL_ROOMS
FROM building_core bc
LEFT JOIN rooms_agg ra ON ra.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN floor_agg fa ON fa.BUILDING_KEY = bc.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY bc.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: List the building names, names of HR departments occupying them, the total gross square footage, the total and average assignable square footage, and the built year per building key.

WITH fac_building_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
    `EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    `ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS COST_COLLECTOR_KEY,
    `COST_CENTER_CODE` AS COST_CENTER_CODE,
    NULLIF(`DATE_BUILT`, '') AS DATE_BUILT
  FROM fac_building
  WHERE `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
),
-- aggregate HR department identifiers per building from the two possible mapping columns
building_hr_agg AS (
  SELECT
    fb.BUILDING_KEY,
    NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dept ORDER BY dept SEPARATOR ',')), '') AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT BUILDING_KEY,
           CASE WHEN COST_COLLECTOR_KEY IS NOT NULL AND COST_COLLECTOR_KEY != '' THEN COST_COLLECTOR_KEY
                WHEN COST_CENTER_CODE IS NOT NULL AND COST_CENTER_CODE != '' THEN COST_CENTER_CODE
                ELSE NULL END AS dept
    FROM fac_building_canonical
  ) fb
  WHERE fb.dept IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_KEY
),
-- numeric aggregates: sum/avg should ignore NULLs; cast to decimal to ensure numeric math
building_area_agg AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_KEY,
    SUM(CAST(EXT_GROSS_AREA AS DECIMAL(20,6))) AS TOTAL_EXT_GROSS_AREA,
    SUM(CAST(ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(20,6))) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    CASE
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(CAST(ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS DECIMAL(20,6))) / SUM(CASE WHEN ASSIGNABLE_AREA IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    END AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    -- pick any non-null DATE_BUILT for the building (MAX used to prefer a value if multiple)
    MAX(DATE_BUILT) AS DATE_BUILT_RAW
  FROM fac_building_canonical
  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
)
SELECT
  a.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fb.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  bha.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  a.TOTAL_EXT_GROSS_AREA AS TOTAL_EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  a.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  a.AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  CASE
    WHEN a.DATE_BUILT_RAW IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN STR_TO_DATE(a.DATE_BUILT_RAW, '%m/%d/%Y') IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(a.DATE_BUILT_RAW, '%m/%d/%Y'), '%m/%d/%Y')
  END AS DATE_BUILT
FROM building_area_agg a
LEFT JOIN fac_building_canonical fb
  ON fb.BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN building_hr_agg bha
  ON bha.BUILDING_KEY = a.BUILDING_KEY
ORDER BY a.BUILDING_KEY

rows.question: Retrieve the titles of subjects offered in the summer term along with their descriptions, responsible faculty names, email address, building name, room name, floor level, building street address, and the total number of types of courses per departmnet.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offered_term_section AS (
  SELECT
    so.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    so.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    so.`SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION` AS SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    so.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    so.`MEET_PLACE` AS MEET_PLACE,
    -- ROOM extraction (simpler portable approach without REGEXP_INSTR)
    TRIM(
      CASE
        WHEN so.`MEET_PLACE` IS NULL OR so.`MEET_PLACE` = '' THEN NULL
        WHEN so.`MEET_PLACE` LIKE '%#%' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.`MEET_PLACE`, '#', -1)
        WHEN so.`MEET_PLACE` REGEXP '[[:space:]][A-Za-z0-9/-]+$' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(so.`MEET_PLACE`, ' ', -1)
        ELSE so.`MEET_PLACE`
      END
    ) AS ROOM,
    -- BUILDING token (leading token of MEET_PLACE if present)
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(
        CASE
          WHEN so.`MEET_PLACE` REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9]+' THEN
            CASE
              WHEN LOCATE(' ', so.`MEET_PLACE`) > 0 THEN LEFT(so.`MEET_PLACE`, LOCATE(' ', so.`MEET_PLACE`) - 1)
              ELSE so.`MEET_PLACE`
            END
          ELSE NULL
        END
      ), ''
    ) AS BUILDING_TOKEN,
    -- FLOOR best-effort (use REGEXP_SUBSTR which MySQL supports as of 8.0; fallback patterns)
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(
        COALESCE(
          (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(so.`MEET_PLACE`, '[Ff][Ll]\\.?[[:space:]]*[0-9]+'))),
          (SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(so.`MEET_PLACE`, '[0-9]{1,2}$'))),
          NULL
        )
      ), ''
    ) AS FLOOR,
    -- FORM_TYPE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(so.`TERM_DURATION`, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN so.`IS_MASTER_SECTION` = 'Y' THEN 'MASTER'
        WHEN so.`IS_LECTURE_SECTION` = 'Y' THEN 'LECTURE'
        WHEN so.`IS_LAB_SECTION` = 'Y' THEN 'LAB'
        WHEN so.`IS_RECITATION_SECTION` = 'Y' THEN 'RECITATION'
        WHEN so.`IS_DESIGN_SECTION` = 'Y' THEN 'DESIGN'
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS FORM_TYPE,
    so.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    so.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    so.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered so
)
, dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    TERM_CODE,
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FORM_TYPE) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES_PER_DEPARTMENT
  FROM subject_offered_term_section
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE, OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT
  s.TERM_CODE,
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  s.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_NAME, fb.BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  COALESCE(fr.`ROOM_NAME`, s.ROOM, CONCAT_WS(' ', s.BUILDING_TOKEN, s.ROOM)) AS ROOM_NAME,
  COALESCE(fr.`FLOOR_LEVEL`, s.FLOOR) AS FLOOR_LEVEL,
  COALESCE(b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS, fb.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS) AS BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS,
  s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  dc.TOTAL_DISTINCT_COURSE_TYPES_PER_DEPARTMENT
FROM subject_offered_term_section s
LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
  ON s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ed.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN dept_counts dc
  ON s.TERM_CODE = dc.TERM_CODE
     AND s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = dc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
-- attempt joins to facility tables if they exist; these LEFT JOINs are safe when tables are absent (will error if truly absent)
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms fr
  ON (
       (s.BUILDING_TOKEN IS NOT NULL AND fr.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.BUILDING_TOKEN AND s.ROOM IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM_NAME = s.ROOM)
       OR (s.ROOM IS NOT NULL AND fr.ROOM_NAME = s.ROOM)
     )
LEFT JOIN fac_building b
  ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON (b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NULL AND s.BUILDING_TOKEN IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NUMBER = s.BUILDING_TOKEN)
WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU'
  AND ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL
  AND (
        (b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL)
        OR (fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND fb.BUILDING_STREET_ADDRESS IS NOT NULL)
        OR (b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NULL AND fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY IS NULL) -- allow rows even if building lookup failed, keep result but building fields null
      )
  AND (fr.ROOM_NAME IS NOT NULL OR s.ROOM IS NOT NULL OR s.BUILDING_TOKEN IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE
