rows.question: What is the category title, version, department name, school name, total number of courses for each course level, and the total number of degree-granting courses for each CIP category code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH cip_programs AS (
  SELECT
    `PROGRAM_CODE`,
    `CATEGORY_TITLE`,
    `VERSION`
  FROM `cip_with_version`
  GROUP BY
    `PROGRAM_CODE`,
    `CATEGORY_TITLE`,
    `VERSION`
)
SELECT
  cp.PROGRAM_CODE,
  cp.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  cp.VERSION,
  -- most common non-null department_name for the program (fallback to any if none non-null)
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
     FROM sis_course_description sd2
     WHERE sd2.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cp.PROGRAM_CODE
       AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
     LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT sd3.DEPARTMENT_NAME
     FROM sis_course_description sd3
     WHERE sd3.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cp.PROGRAM_CODE
     LIMIT 1)
  ) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- most common non-null school_name for the program (fallback to any if none non-null)
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT sd4.SCHOOL_NAME
     FROM sis_course_description sd4
     WHERE sd4.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cp.PROGRAM_CODE
       AND sd4.SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL
     GROUP BY sd4.SCHOOL_NAME
     ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
     LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT sd5.SCHOOL_NAME
     FROM sis_course_description sd5
     WHERE sd5.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cp.PROGRAM_CODE
     LIMIT 1)
  ) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  -- counts only courses with a non-null COURSE (per requirement)
  SUM(CASE WHEN sd.COURSE IS NOT NULL AND sd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_COURSES_U,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sd.COURSE IS NOT NULL AND sd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_COURSES_G,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sd.COURSE IS NOT NULL AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_DEGREE_GRANTING_COURSES
FROM cip_programs cp
LEFT JOIN sis_course_description sd
  ON sd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE = cp.PROGRAM_CODE
GROUP BY
  cp.PROGRAM_CODE,
  cp.CATEGORY_TITLE,
  cp.VERSION
ORDER BY cp.PROGRAM_CODE

rows.question: What is the total number of library materials, the minimum and maximum publication years, and the total number of materials status for each course name?

WITH library_course_instructor_normalized AS (
  SELECT
    lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    lci.COURSE_NAME,
    UPPER(TRIM(
      REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(lci.COURSE_NAME, ''), '[[:punct:]]+', ' '),
        '  ', ' '
      )
    )) AS COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED,
    lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    UPPER(TRIM(
      REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, ''), '(?i)\\b(DR|PROF|PROFESSOR|MR|MRS|MS)\\.?\\b', ' '),
          '[[:punct:]]+', ' '
        ),
        '  ', ' '
      )
    )) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED,
    TRIM(lci.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT,
    TRIM(lci.UNIT) AS UNIT,
    TRIM(lci.DATE_FROM) AS DATE_FROM,
    TRIM(lci.DATE_TO) AS DATE_TO
  FROM library_course_instructor lci
),
library_course_instructor_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    n.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(n.COURSE_NAME, ''), n.COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED) AS COURSE_NAME,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(n.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, ''), n.INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    n.DEPARTMENT,
    n.UNIT,
    NULLIF(n.DATE_FROM, '') AS DATE_FROM,
    NULLIF(n.DATE_TO, '') AS DATE_TO,
    NULLIF(TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(n.UNIT, '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?')), '') AS UNIT_CODE
  FROM library_course_instructor_normalized n
)
SELECT
  c.COURSE_NAME,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.total_materials_count), 0) AS total_materials,
  MIN(r.min_publication_year) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(r.max_publication_year) AS max_publication_year,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.total_material_status_count), 0) AS total_material_status_count
FROM library_course_instructor_canonical c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials_count,
    MIN(NULLIF(tm.YEAR_OF_PUBLICATION, '')) AS min_publication_year,
    MAX(NULLIF(tm.YEAR_OF_PUBLICATION, '')) AS max_publication_year,
    COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS total_material_status_count
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrmd
  LEFT JOIN tip_material tm
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_KEY
  GROUP BY lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
) r
  ON c.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = r.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY
WHERE c.COURSE_NAME IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.COURSE_NAME
ORDER BY total_materials DESC

library_instructor_material_link AS (
  SELECT
    lci.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`,
    lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME`,
    lmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
  FROM
    `library_course_instructor` lci
    JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lmd
      ON lci.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY` = lmd.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`
),
enrollment_by_instructor AS (
  SELECT
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    SUM(COALESCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,0)) AS SUM_ENROLLED
  FROM library_subject_offered
  GROUP BY RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME`, liml.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME`) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  lci.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT liml.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`) AS TOTAL_MATERIALS,
  MIN(lrcy.`CATALOG_YEAR_NUM`) AS MIN_PUBLICATION_YEAR,
  MAX(lrcy.`CATALOG_YEAR_NUM`) AS MAX_PUBLICATION_YEAR,
  COALESCE(ebi.SUM_ENROLLED, 0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM library_instructor_material_link liml
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog_years lrcy
  ON liml.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrcy.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON liml.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY` = lci.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`
LEFT JOIN enrollment_by_instructor ebi
  -- avoid referencing nonexistent MIT_ID column in library_course_instructor; match by instructor name first,
  -- and also match if RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID equals the MIT ID stored in INSTRUCTOR_NAME when formatted (best-effort)
  ON (
       (lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` = ebi.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
    OR (liml.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND liml.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` = ebi.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME)
     )
WHERE liml.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY lci.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`, COALESCE(lci.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME`, liml.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME`)
ORDER BY INSTRUCTOR_NAME ASC

rows.question: What is the material status, term description, total number of courses and materials, occurences in departments and school, and the total number of instructors for each library material status code and term code?
rows.pred_sql:
WITH term_code_descriptions_preferred AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(at.`TERM_CODE`, ata.`TERM_CODE`) AS `TERM_CODE`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`, ''), ata.`TERM_DESCRIPTION`) AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_START_DATE`, ''), ata.`TERM_START_DATE`) AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`TERM_END_DATE`, ''), ata.`TERM_END_DATE`) AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, ''), ata.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`) AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT `TERM_CODE` FROM academic_terms) t
    LEFT JOIN academic_terms AS at
      ON at.`TERM_CODE` = t.`TERM_CODE`
    LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all AS ata
      ON ata.`TERM_CODE` = t.`TERM_CODE`
  UNION
  SELECT
    ata2.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    ata2.`TERM_DESCRIPTION` AS `TERM_DESCRIPTION`,
    ata2.`TERM_START_DATE` AS `TERM_START_DATE`,
    ata2.`TERM_END_DATE` AS `TERM_END_DATE`,
    ata2.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT `TERM_CODE` FROM academic_terms_all) t2
    LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all AS ata2
      ON ata2.`TERM_CODE` = t2.`TERM_CODE`
    LEFT JOIN academic_terms AS at2
      ON at2.`TERM_CODE` = t2.`TERM_CODE`
  WHERE at2.`TERM_CODE` IS NULL
)
SELECT
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  td.TERM_CODE,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  term_code_descriptions_preferred.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(td.SUBJECT_ID,
                         tso.SUBJECT_ID,
                         tso.COURSE_NUMBER,
                         tso.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER,
                         lso.SUBJECT_ID,
                         rmd.SUBJECT_ID)) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_COURSES,
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
                         td.ISBN,
                         tm.ISBN)) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_MATERIALS,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        (tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> '')
        OR (tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> '')
        OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE <> '')
        OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> '')
        OR (rmd.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND rmd.SUBJECT_ID <> '')
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS TOTAL_DEPARTMENT_OCCURRENCES,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN (
        (tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME <> '')
        OR (lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IS NOT NULL AND lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME <> '')
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS TOTAL_SCHOOL_OCCURRENCES,
  COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(NULLIF(
    COALESCE(
      tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
      lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
      lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME
    ), ''), '')) AS TOTAL_DISTINCT_INSTRUCTORS
FROM tip_detail td
JOIN tip_material tm
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN tip_material_status tms
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
LEFT JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
LEFT JOIN library_subject_offered lso
  ON td.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE
  AND (
       COALESCE(td.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) = lso.SUBJECT_ID
       OR (tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
      )
LEFT JOIN library_reserve_matrl_detail rmd
  ON td.TERM_CODE = rmd.TERM_CODE
  -- match by TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY if present in both, otherwise try SUBJECT_ID
  AND (
       (td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NOT NULL AND td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = rmd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY)
    OR (td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY IS NULL AND COALESCE(td.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_ID) IS NOT NULL
        AND COALESCE(td.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_ID) = rmd.SUBJECT_ID)
      )
LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
  ON lci.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE
  AND (
       lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
    OR lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME = lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  )
LEFT JOIN term_code_descriptions_preferred
  ON td.TERM_CODE = term_code_descriptions_preferred.TERM_CODE
WHERE td.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
  AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  td.TERM_CODE,
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS,
  term_code_descriptions_preferred.TERM_DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY
  tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE,
  td.TERM_CODE

rows.question: For building 36, list all space units, their floor and building name, building street address, their space usage, and the number of organizations and space units on the same building and floor.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  suc.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(suc.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ''), suc.SPACE_UNIT, suc.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS SPACE_UNIT,
  suc.FLOOR,
  COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NAME, fac_b.BUILDING_NAME) AS BUILDING_NAME,
  TRIM(
    CONCAT_WS(' ',
      fba.STREET_NUMBER,
      fba.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
      fba.STREET_NAME,
      fba.STREET_SUFFIX,
      fba.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
      fba.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX
    )
  ) AS STREET_ADDRESS,
  COALESCE(su.SPACE_USAGE, su_direct.SU_COL, suc.SPACE_USAGE) AS SPACE_USAGE,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
        SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
        SPACE_UNIT,
        FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
        FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        FLOOR,
        SPACE_USAGE
      FROM space_unit
      UNION ALL
      -- placeholder union branch kept but disabled (no rows) to mirror original pattern
      SELECT
        SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
        SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
        SPACE_UNIT,
        NULL AS FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
        NULL AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        FLOOR,
        SPACE_USAGE
      FROM cis_course_catalog
      WHERE 0
    ) s2
    WHERE s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = suc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
      AND (
        (s2.FLOOR IS NULL AND suc.FLOOR IS NULL)
        OR (s2.FLOOR = suc.FLOOR)
      )
  ) AS ORGANIZATION_COUNT_ON_BUILDING_FLOOR,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
        SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
        SPACE_UNIT,
        FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
        FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        FLOOR,
        SPACE_USAGE
      FROM space_unit
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
        SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
        SPACE_UNIT,
        NULL AS FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
        NULL AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
        FLOOR,
        SPACE_USAGE
      FROM cis_course_catalog
      WHERE 0
    ) s3
    WHERE s3.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = suc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
      AND (
        (s3.FLOOR IS NULL AND suc.FLOOR IS NULL)
        OR (s3.FLOOR = suc.FLOOR)
      )
  ) AS SPACE_UNIT_COUNT_ON_BUILDING_FLOOR
FROM (
  -- canonicalize space_unit rows from available table(s).
  SELECT
    s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY,
    s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SPACE_UNIT, ''), s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS SPACE_UNIT,
    s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY,
    s.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
    s.FLOOR,
    s.SPACE_USAGE
  FROM space_unit s
) suc
LEFT JOIN fac_building fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = suc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building fac_b
  ON fac_b.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = suc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building_address fba
  ON fba.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = suc.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  AND fba.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'
LEFT JOIN space_detail sd
  ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = suc.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
LEFT JOIN space_usage su
  ON su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT SPACE_UNIT_KEY AS SU_KEY, SPACE_USAGE AS SU_COL FROM space_unit WHERE SPACE_USAGE IS NOT NULL
) su_direct
  ON su_direct.SU_KEY = suc.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
WHERE COALESCE(fb.BUILDING_NUMBER, fac_b.BUILDING_NUMBER) = '36'
ORDER BY
  suc.FLOOR,
  SPACE_UNIT

rows.question: For each distinct mailing list containing more than 1000 people and with a name starting with A (case insensitive), provide its name, whether it is a mailing list, whether it is a moira group, whether it is a NFS group, the owner of the mailing list, and the number of people in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` AS `LIST_NAME`,
  'Y' AS `IS_MAILING_LIST`,     -- no explicit mailing_list flag in schema; assume these are mailing lists
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`) LIKE '%moira%' THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS `IS_MOIRA_GROUP`,
  'N' AS `IS_NFS_GROUP`,        -- no NFS flag available in schema; default to N
  m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS `OWNER`,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.`SECTION_ID`) AS `NUM_MEMBERS`
FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered` AS m
JOIN `drupal_course_catalog` AS co
  ON co.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` = m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`
WHERE m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` IS NOT NULL
  AND m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME` <> ''
  AND LOWER(m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`) LIKE 'a%'
GROUP BY
  m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID`,
  m.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT co.`SECTION_ID`) > 1000

rows.question: List the mailing lists with the largest number of members and the least number of members, including their names, owners, public status, hidden status, and number of members in the list. If a mailing list has multiple owners, create a separate entry for each owner. Similarly, if multiple lists share the minimum or maximum member count, include all those lists.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH moira_list_core AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN m.IS_PUBLIC IN ('Y','y','1','t','true','TRUE') THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_PUBLIC,
    CASE
      WHEN m.IS_HIDDEN IN ('Y','y','1','t','true','TRUE') THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_HIDDEN
  FROM moira_list m
  -- no aggregation needed here; keep one row per list key/name
),
moira_list_member_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
    COALESCE(counts.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS MEMBER_COUNT
  FROM moira_list AS m
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      mdl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
      COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT
    FROM moira_list_detail AS mdl
    WHERE mdl.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mdl.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
  ) AS counts
    ON counts.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
),
moira_list_owners AS (
  -- include all owners; MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY is the key of the list they own
  SELECT
    MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY,
    OWNER
  FROM moira_list_owner
)
SELECT
  mlc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  mlc.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  mlo.OWNER AS MOIRA_LIST_OWNER,
  mlc.IS_PUBLIC,
  mlc.IS_HIDDEN,
  COALESCE(mlmc.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS MEMBER_COUNT
FROM moira_list_core mlc
JOIN moira_list_member_counts mlmc
  ON mlc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlmc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN moira_list_owners mlo
  ON mlc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mlo.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY
WHERE COALESCE(mlmc.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) IN (
  (SELECT MAX(MEMBER_COUNT) FROM moira_list_member_counts),
  (SELECT MIN(MEMBER_COUNT) FROM moira_list_member_counts)
)
ORDER BY MEMBER_COUNT DESC, mlc.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, MOIRA_LIST_OWNER

rows.question: For email lists with names starting with C (case insensitive) and containing faculty who teach courses in the summer in financial aid years after 2001, provide the name of the list, the number of people in the list, and the number of faculty in the list.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
summer_teaching_records_by_person AS (
  -- canonical list of MIT_IDs who taught in a summer term (TERM_CODE, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE or SO_TERM_CODE ending with 'SU')
  SELECT DISTINCT
    cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN cs.TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}SU$' THEN LEFT(cs.TERM_CODE,4)
      WHEN cs.TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{6}SU$' THEN LEFT(cs.TERM_CODE,4)
      WHEN cs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}SU$' THEN LEFT(cs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,4)
      WHEN cs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{6}SU$' THEN LEFT(cs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,4)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS TERM_YEAR
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cs
  WHERE (cs.TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND cs.TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU')
     OR (cs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND cs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU')

  UNION

  SELECT DISTINCT
    d.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}SU$' THEN LEFT(d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,4)
      WHEN d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{6}SU$' THEN LEFT(d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,4)
      WHEN d.SO_TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}SU$' THEN LEFT(d.SO_TERM_CODE,4)
      WHEN d.SO_TERM_CODE RLIKE '^[0-9]{6}SU$' THEN LEFT(d.SO_TERM_CODE,4)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS TERM_YEAR
  FROM drupal_course_catalog d
  WHERE (d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU')
     OR (d.SO_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL AND d.SO_TERM_CODE LIKE '%SU')
),
summer_faculty_after_2001 AS (
  -- keep only valid MIT_IDs and terms after 2001
  SELECT DISTINCT MIT_ID
  FROM summer_teaching_records_by_person
  WHERE MIT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND TERM_YEAR IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(TERM_YEAR AS UNSIGNED) > 2001
)
SELECT
  ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS list_name,
  COUNT(mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_KEY) AS member_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN sf.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(mld.MEMBER_MIT_ID, mld.MIT_ID, SUBSTRING_INDEX(mld.MEMBER_EMAIL, '@', 1))
    ELSE NULL
  END) AS faculty_count
FROM moira_list ml
JOIN moira_list_member mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN summer_faculty_after_2001 sf
  ON sf.MIT_ID = COALESCE(mld.MEMBER_MIT_ID, mld.MIT_ID, SUBSTRING_INDEX(mld.MEMBER_EMAIL, '@', 1))
WHERE ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME LIKE 'C%' COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
  AND ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME NOT LIKE '%@%'
GROUP BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY ml.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: Regarding the mailing list about duo users, provide the number of students in this list, and the number of departments and schools associated with these students.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  -- number of distinct student MIT IDs on the 'candle-duo-users' Moira list
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.MEMBER_MITID)
   FROM `moira_list` l
   JOIN `moira_list_member` m ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
   JOIN `sis_person` s ON s.MIT_ID = m.MEMBER_MITID
   WHERE l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
     AND m.MEMBER_MITID IS NOT NULL
     AND TRIM(m.MEMBER_MITID) <> ''
     AND s.PERSON_TYPE = 'STUDENT'
  ) AS num_students_in_list,
  -- number of distinct departments associated with those active student academic affiliations
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER)
   FROM `moira_list` l
   JOIN `moira_list_member` m ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
   JOIN `sis_person` s ON s.MIT_ID = m.MEMBER_MITID
   JOIN `sis_academic_affiliation` sa ON sa.MIT_ID = m.MEMBER_MITID
   WHERE l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
     AND m.MEMBER_MITID IS NOT NULL
     AND TRIM(m.MEMBER_MITID) <> ''
     AND s.PERSON_TYPE = 'STUDENT'
     AND sa.AFFILIATION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
     AND sa.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
     AND TRIM(sa.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER) <> ''
  ) AS num_departments,
  -- number of distinct schools associated with those active student academic affiliations
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.SCHOOL_CODE)
   FROM `moira_list` l
   JOIN `moira_list_member` m ON l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
   JOIN `sis_person` s ON s.MIT_ID = m.MEMBER_MITID
   JOIN `sis_academic_affiliation` sa ON sa.MIT_ID = m.MEMBER_MITID
   WHERE l.MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'candle-duo-users'
     AND m.MEMBER_MITID IS NOT NULL
     AND TRIM(m.MEMBER_MITID) <> ''
     AND s.PERSON_TYPE = 'STUDENT'
     AND sa.AFFILIATION_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
     AND sa.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL
     AND TRIM(sa.SCHOOL_CODE) <> ''
  ) AS num_schools

rows.question: For faculty who are responsible for courses in 2023 fall term, list the name of mailing lists with ten members that they subscribe to, the number of faculty in these lists, and the number of courses associated with those faculty.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH faculty_with_courses AS (
  SELECT
    dri.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS MIT_ID,
    COALESCE(dri.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`, ed.`FULL_NAME`) AS FACULTY_NAME,
    dri.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,
    dri.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE
  FROM drupal_course_catalog dri
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON dri.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` = ed.`MIT_ID`
  WHERE dri.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` LIKE '2023%' /* year 2023 */
    AND RIGHT(dri.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`, 2) = 'FA' /* fall term (TERM_CODE formatted YYYYTT) */
    AND dri.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
),
faculty_course_counts AS (
  SELECT
    MIT_ID,
    FACULTY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT SECTION_ID) AS COURSES_COUNT
  FROM faculty_with_courses
  GROUP BY MIT_ID, FACULTY_NAME
),
moira_lists_of_size_10 AS (
  -- infer mailing lists from drupal_course_catalog RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID subscriptions stored in DRUPAL (assume mailing lists live in drupal_employee_directory.EMAIL_ADDRESS as list addresses with 'moira' in name)
  -- Because schema does not include explicit subscription table, assume drupal_employee_directory.EMAIL_ADDRESS contains comma-separated mailing lists a person subscribes to.
  SELECT
    dd.`MIT_ID`,
    TRIM(mlist) AS MAILING_LIST
  FROM drupal_employee_directory dd
  CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
    CONCAT('["', REPLACE(COALESCE(dd.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`, ''), ',', '","'), '"]'),
    "$[*]" COLUMNS (mlist VARCHAR(255) PATH "$")
  ) jt
  WHERE dd.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE` LIKE '%MOIRA%' /* heuristic: MAILING lists flagged with MOIRA in this field */
),
mailing_list_members AS (
  -- Build members per mailing list by scanning drupal_employee_directory.EMAIL_ADDRESS field assuming it holds comma-separated list subscriptions (heuristic)
  SELECT
    TRIM(m) AS MAILING_LIST,
    dd.`MIT_ID`
  FROM drupal_employee_directory dd
  CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
    CONCAT('["', REPLACE(COALESCE(dd.`EMAIL_ADDRESS`, ''), ',', '","'), '"]'),
    "$[*]" COLUMNS (m VARCHAR(255) PATH "$")
  ) jt
  WHERE dd.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` LIKE '%moira%' OR dd.`EMAIL_ADDRESS` LIKE '%MOIRA%'
),
lists_size_10 AS (
  SELECT
    MAILING_LIST,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS MEMBER_COUNT,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT MIT_ID) AS MEMBER_IDS
  FROM mailing_list_members
  GROUP BY MAILING_LIST
  HAVING MEMBER_COUNT = 10

rows.question: For each course instructor in the 'keeper-zephyr' mailing list, provide the name of mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest and latest publication years, and total number of enrolled students.
rows.pred_sql:
-- For each course instructor who is a member of the 'keeper-zephyr' Moira list,
-- list the mailing lists they subscribe to, instructor name, earliest & latest publication years,
-- and total number of enrolled students.
-- This version tolerates either moira_list_members or moira_members existing (uses UNION ALL),
-- and tolerates missing optional tables by using LEFT JOINs; if a source table truly doesn't exist,
-- adjust by creating a view or table with that name or replace with the correct table.
WITH
-- gather keeper-zephyr members from either possible moira table name
moira_src AS (
  SELECT MOIRA_LIST_NAME, MEMBER_KEY, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_NAME
  FROM moira_list_members
  WHERE MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT MOIRA_LIST_NAME, MEMBER_KEY, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_NAME
  FROM moira_members
  WHERE MOIRA_LIST_NAME = 'keeper-zephyr'
),
-- canonical instructor/person row for each member found on keeper-zephyr
instructor_people AS (
  SELECT
    m.MEMBER_KEY AS MIT_ID,
    m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
    m.MEMBER_EMAIL,
    COALESCE(ed.FULL_NAME,
             NULLIF(m.MEMBER_NAME, ''),
             NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', ed.FIRST_NAME, ed.LAST_NAME), ''),
             m.MEMBER_EMAIL) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    COALESCE(ed.EMAIL_ADDRESS, m.MEMBER_EMAIL) AS EMAIL_ADDRESS
  FROM moira_src m
  LEFT JOIN employee_directory ed
    ON m.MEMBER_KEY = ed.MIT_ID
),
-- all moira memberships from either table so we can list all lists each instructor subscribes to
all_moira_members AS (
  SELECT MEMBER_KEY, MEMBER_EMAIL, MOIRA_LIST_NAME FROM moira_list_members
  UNION ALL
  SELECT MEMBER_KEY, MEMBER_EMAIL, MOIRA_LIST_NAME FROM moira_members
),
-- For each instructor/person, find the mailing lists they subscribe to (match by MIT_ID or email)
instructor_lists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ip.MIT_ID,
    ip.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
    amm.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS SUBSCRIBED_LIST
  FROM instructor_people ip
  JOIN all_moira_members amm
    ON (amm.MEMBER_KEY IS NOT NULL AND amm.MEMBER_KEY = ip.MIT_ID)
    OR (amm.MEMBER_EMAIL IS NOT NULL AND amm.MEMBER_EMAIL = ip.EMAIL_ADDRESS)
),
-- Publications per author: parse year or year-range like '1999-2001'
instructor_publications AS (
  SELECT
    pa.AUTHOR_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    MIN(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.PUBLICATION_YEAR, '-', 1) AS UNSIGNED)) AS EARLIEST_YEAR,
    MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.PUBLICATION_YEAR, '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED)) AS LATEST_YEAR
  FROM publication_authors pa
  JOIN publications p ON pa.PUBLICATION_ID = p.PUBLICATION_ID
  WHERE p.PUBLICATION_YEAR IS NOT NULL AND p.PUBLICATION_YEAR <> ''
    AND pa.AUTHOR_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND pa.AUTHOR_MIT_ID <> ''
  GROUP BY pa.AUTHOR_MIT_ID
),
-- Enrollment counts per instructor based on sections/enrollments
instructor_enrollments AS (
  SELECT
    s.INSTRUCTOR_MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.STUDENT_MIT_ID) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED
  FROM sections s
  JOIN enrollments e ON s.SECTION_ID = e.SECTION_ID
  WHERE s.INSTRUCTOR_MIT_ID IS NOT NULL AND s.INSTRUCTOR_MIT_ID <> ''
  GROUP BY s.INSTRUCTOR_MIT_ID
)
SELECT
  ip.MIT_ID,
  ip.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSCRIBED_LIST ORDER BY SUBSCRIBED_LIST SEPARATOR ', ')
     FROM instructor_lists il2 WHERE il2.MIT_ID = ip.MIT_ID),
    ''
  ) AS MAILING_LISTS,
  ipub.EARLIEST_YEAR   AS EARLIEST_PUBLICATION_YEAR,
  ipub.LATEST_YEAR     AS LATEST_PUBLICATION_YEAR,
  COALESCE(ien.TOTAL_ENROLLED, 0) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM instructor_people ip
LEFT JOIN instructor_publications ipub ON ip.MIT_ID = ipub.MIT_ID
LEFT JOIN instructor_enrollments ien ON ip.MIT_ID = ien.MIT_ID
ORDER BY ip.INSTRUCTOR_NAME

rows.question: For the building with the most floors, list the building name and the names of the mailing lists staring with a (case insensitive) that the building employees with kerberos starting with c (case insensitive) subscribe to.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH
fac_building_norm AS (
  SELECT
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`,
    `NUM_OF_ROOMS`
  FROM fac_building
),
buildings_norm AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
    `BUILDING_NAME`
  FROM buildings
),
building_keys_with_names AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(f.FAC_BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_KEY) AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(f.BUILDING_NUMBER, ''), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_NUMBER, '')) AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(f.BUILDING_NAME, ''), NULLIF(b.BUILDING_NAME, '')) AS BUILDING_NAME
  FROM fac_building_norm f
  LEFT JOIN buildings_norm b
    ON (f.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND f.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND b.BUILDING_NUMBER = f.BUILDING_NUMBER)
       OR ((f.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR f.BUILDING_NUMBER = '') AND b.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND b.BUILDING_NAME <> '' AND b.BUILDING_NAME = f.BUILDING_NAME)
  UNION
  SELECT
    b.BUILDING_KEY,
    b.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    b.BUILDING_NAME
  FROM buildings_norm b
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fac_building_norm f2
    WHERE (f2.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND f2.BUILDING_NUMBER <> '' AND f2.BUILDING_NUMBER = b.BUILDING_NUMBER)
       OR ((f2.BUILDING_NUMBER IS NULL OR f2.BUILDING_NUMBER = '') AND f2.BUILDING_NAME IS NOT NULL AND f2.BUILDING_NAME <> '' AND f2.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME)
  )
),
fac_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `FLOOR`) AS floor_count
  FROM fac_floor
  GROUP BY `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
),
fclt_floor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    `BUILDING_KEY`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `FLOOR`) AS floor_count
  FROM fclt_floor
  GROUP BY `BUILDING_KEY`
),
-- emulate FULL JOIN by union of left and right joins
total_floors_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    f.BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(f.floor_count,0) + COALESCE(x.floor_count,0) AS total_floors
  FROM fac_floor_counts f
  LEFT JOIN fclt_floor_counts x ON f.BUILDING_KEY = x.BUILDING_KEY
  UNION
  SELECT
    x.BUILDING_KEY,
    COALESCE(f2.floor_count,0) + COALESCE(x.floor_count,0) AS total_floors
  FROM fclt_floor_counts x
  LEFT JOIN fac_floor_counts f2 ON x.BUILDING_KEY = f2.BUILDING_KEY
),
max_floor_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_floors) AS max_floors FROM total_floors_per_building
),
buildings_with_max_floors AS (
  SELECT t.BUILDING_KEY, t.total_floors
  FROM total_floors_per_building t
  JOIN max_floor_count m ON t.total_floors = m.max_floors
)
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME,
  LOWER(m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) AS MOIRA_LIST_NAME
FROM buildings_with_max_floors mb
JOIN building_keys_with_names b ON b.BUILDING_KEY = mb.BUILDING_KEY
JOIN employee_directory ed
  ON ed.OFFICE_LOCATION = b.BUILDING_NUMBER
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(ed.KRB_NAME, '')) LIKE 'c%'
JOIN moira_list_detail mld
  ON mld.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID = COALESCE(ed.MIT_ID, ed.KRB_NAME)
JOIN moira_list m ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = mld.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
WHERE LOWER(m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME) LIKE 'a%'
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME, m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

WITH moira_list_faculty_members AS (
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
  -- canonicalize member full name: prefer detail full name if present, else use member text
  COALESCE(NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, ''), md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
  -- resolved MIT ID: prefer explicit MIT id on detail, else try to match faculty by name (will be the matched FACULTY_MIT_ID)
  NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') AS MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID_resolved,
  -- faculty columns (may be NULL if not matched)
  f.MIT_ID AS FACULTY_MIT_ID,
  f.FULL_NAME AS FACULTY_FULL_NAME,
  f.LAST_NAME AS FACULTY_LAST_NAME,
  -- is_faculty_flag: 1 if member is identified as faculty either by explicit MIT id matching faculty table
  -- or by name match to faculty roster; 0 otherwise
  CASE
    WHEN (NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') = f.MIT_ID) THEN 1
    WHEN f.MIT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS is_faculty_flag
FROM moira_list AS m
JOIN moira_list_detail AS md
  ON md.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN employee_directory AS f
  -- first try to match by explicit MIT ID on the moira member detail
  ON (
       (NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NOT NULL AND f.MIT_ID = NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, ''))
     )
LEFT JOIN (
  -- name-based faculty match: try to match member text to employee full name or last/first combinations.
  -- This derived table finds a faculty row when the moira member text equals or contains the faculty name pieces.
  SELECT ed.MIT_ID, ed.FULL_NAME, ed.LAST_NAME
  FROM employee_directory ed
) AS fname
  ON (
       -- only use name-match when there wasn't already an explicit MIT ID match to 'f' above
       (NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, '') IS NULL)
       AND (
            -- exact full name match (case-insensitive)
            LOWER(NULLIF(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, '')) = LOWER(fname.FULL_NAME)
            OR LOWER(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) = LOWER(fname.FULL_NAME)
            -- or member string contains "<last>, <first>" or "<first> <last>"
            OR (fname.LAST_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(fname.LAST_NAME), '%'))
       )
     )
-- prefer explicit MIT-ID join result when present; otherwise pull name-match faculty info into f columns
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    /* pass-through to allow COALESCE choice between explicit-id join (f) and name-match (fname) */
    /* no rows here; this alias is used only to enable COALESCE logic below when f is null */
    NULL AS MIT_ID, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS LAST_NAME
) AS filler ON 1=0
),
fac_building_base AS (
SELECT
  `FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  `BUILDING_NAME` AS BUILDING_NAME,
  `BUILDING_NUMBER` AS BUILDING_NUMBER,
  `DATE_BUILT` AS DATE_BUILT,
  `NUM_OF_ROOMS` AS NUM_OF_ROOMS,
  `EXT_GROSS_AREA` AS EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  `ASSIGNABLE_AREA` AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS COST_COLLECTOR_KEY
FROM `fac_building`
),
tip_subject_material_link AS (
SELECT
  td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
  td.`TIP_MATERIAL_KEY`,
  tso.`TERM_CODE`,
  tso.`SUBJECT_ID`
FROM `tip_detail` td
JOIN `tip_subject_offered` tso
  ON td.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = tso.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
/* note: keep joinable keys from source tables */
),
dlc_core AS (
SELECT
  `FAC_BUILDING`.`COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS `DLC_KEY`,
  NULLIF(
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''),
      NULLIF(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, ''),
      NULLIF(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAMED_FOR`, '')
    ),
    ''
  ) AS `DLC_NAME`
FROM `fac_building`
GROUP BY `FAC_BUILDING`.`COST_COLLECTOR_KEY`
),
iap_person_roles AS (
SELECT
  isp.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
  isp.PERSON_ROLE,
  isp.PERSON_NAME,
  isp.PERSON_EMAIL,
  isp.PERSON_ORGANIZATION
FROM
  iap_subject_person isp
WHERE
  isp.PERSON_NAME IS NOT NULL
),
fac_building_with_room_metrics AS (
SELECT
  b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
  b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  b.`DATE_BUILT` AS `DATE_BUILT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`ROOM_COUNT`, 0) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`,
  -- NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY is a simple proxy: one employee per X square feet.
  -- The divisor is a literal and should be supplied/adjusted outside the view if needed.
  -- Here we use 150 sqft per employee as the proxy divisor lifted out as a literal.
  FLOOR(COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) / 150) AS `NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY`
FROM
  fac_building b
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregated room metrics per building
  SELECT
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`) AS `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
    COUNT(*) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
    -- prefer assignable area where available, else use ext gross area per-room if provided.
    SUM(COALESCE(rb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`, rb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`, 0)) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`
  FROM
    fac_building rb
  -- rooms may be stored in a related table in some schemas; if there were a fac_room table
  -- you'd aggregate from that table instead. Here we conservatively treat fac_building rows
  -- that include NUM_OF_ROOMS and assignable area as proxies for room-level counts.
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
) room_aggr
  ON room_aggr.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
),
library_course_instructor_normalized AS (
SELECT
  -- primary key carried through
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,

  -- raw course name as provided
  lci.COURSE_NAME,

  -- normalized course name: trim, collapse internal spaces, uppercase,
  -- remove punctuation commonly interfering with joins, and keep numeric parts
  UPPER(
    TRIM(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.COURSE_NAME, '[[:punct:]]', ' '),    -- replace punctuation with space
        '\\s+', ' '                                             -- collapse multiple spaces to single
      )
    )
  ) AS COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED,

  -- raw instructor name as provided
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,

  -- normalized instructor name: trim, collapse spaces, uppercase,
  -- remove punctuation, remove titles (Dr, Prof, Mr, Mrs, Ms) for better matching
  UPPER(
    TRIM(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, '(?i)\\b(DR|PROF|PROFESSOR|MR|MRS|MS)\\.?\\b', ' '), -- remove common titles
          '[[:punct:]]', ' '                                                          -- replace punctuation
        ),
        '\\s+', ' '
      )
    )
  ) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED,

  -- department and unit carried through (trimmed)
  TRIM(lci.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT,
  TRIM(lci.UNIT) AS UNIT,

  -- date range fields: keep as-is but trimmed; consumers can parse further
  TRIM(lci.DATE_FROM) AS DATE_FROM,
  TRIM(lci.DATE_TO) AS DATE_TO

FROM library_course_instructor lci
),
faculty_managed_subjects AS (
SELECT
  -- faculty mit id from subject_offered responsible faculty
  `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS faculty_mit_id,
  `SUBJECT_ID` AS subject_id,
  `TERM_CODE` AS term_code,
  'course_subject_offered' AS source_table
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  AND `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` <> ''
  AND `SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  AND `SUBJECT_ID` <> ''

UNION ALL

SELECT
  -- faculty mit id from drupal_course_catalog responsible faculty
  `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS faculty_mit_id,
  `SUBJECT_ID` AS subject_id,
  `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS term_code,
  'drupal_course_catalog' AS source_table
FROM drupal_course_catalog
WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  AND `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` <> ''
  AND `SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  AND `SUBJECT_ID` <> ''

UNION ALL

SELECT
  -- normalized library instructor mapping to subject via tip_subject_material_link join
  li.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED` AS faculty_mit_id, -- note: library normalized holds instructor name; keep as faculty_mit_id per requested column name to preserve joinability
  t.`SUBJECT_ID` AS subject_id,
  t.`TERM_CODE` AS term_code,
  'library_subject_offered' AS source_table
FROM tip_subject_material_link AS t
JOIN library_course_instructor_normalized AS li
  ON t.`TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = li.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`
WHERE li.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED` IS NOT NULL
  AND li.`INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED` <> ''
  AND t.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  AND t.`SUBJECT_ID` <> ''
)
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME AS moira_list_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS faculty_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.subject_id) AS distinct_subject_count
FROM moira_list_faculty_members m
LEFT JOIN faculty_managed_subjects f
  ON m.FACULTY_MIT_ID = f.faculty_mit_id
WHERE m.is_faculty_flag = 'true'
  AND m.FACULTY_LAST_NAME LIKE 'Y%'
GROUP BY m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME
ORDER BY m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME

rows.question: For each assignable organization (excluding 'ADMISSIONS' and those with organization IDs '138' and '250'), provide the organization name, the average and variance of the HR department codes for its associated HR org units, and the number of HR org units per organization, considering only those with a non-null HR department code. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH orgs AS (
  SELECT
    `ORGANIZATION_ID`,
    `ORGANIZATION_NAME`,
    `DLC_KEY`
  FROM `fclt_organization`
  WHERE `ASSIGNABLE` IS NOT NULL
    AND `ASSIGNABLE` != ''
    AND `ORGANIZATION_NAME` != 'ADMISSIONS'
    AND `ORGANIZATION_ID` NOT IN ('138','250')

hr_units AS (
  SELECT
    o.ORGANIZATION_ID,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    hu.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    -- carry a numeric cast for aggregation; use NULL for non-numeric to filter later
    CASE
      WHEN hu.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE` REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
      THEN CAST(hu.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS DECIMAL(38,10))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS HR_DEPT_NUM
  FROM orgs o
  JOIN `hr_org_unit` hu
    ON hu.`DLC_KEY` = o.`DLC_KEY`
  WHERE hu.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    AND hu.`HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE` != ''
)
SELECT
  h.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  AVG(h.HR_DEPT_NUM) AS AVG_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  -- VARIANCE in MySQL returns population variance; apply to the numeric column
  VARIANCE(h.HR_DEPT_NUM) AS VAR_HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COUNT(*) AS HR_ORG_UNIT_COUNT
FROM (
  -- exclude rows where cast produced NULL (non-numeric)
  SELECT ORGANIZATION_ID, ORGANIZATION_NAME, HR_DEPT_NUM
  FROM hr_units
  WHERE HR_DEPT_NUM IS NOT NULL
) h
GROUP BY h.ORGANIZATION_ID, h.ORGANIZATION_NAME
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

rows.question: For each school, what is the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the department budget codes among its departments, what is the full name of the school, and how many unique subject codes are associated with the departments in that school? Only include schools that have a department named "Political Science". Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH departments_per_school_agg_prep AS (
  -- gather departments and their school name and numeric budget code (if numeric)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ctso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(ctso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(ctso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
        THEN CAST(COALESCE(ctso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '') ctso
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '') dcc
    ON ctso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  UNION

  -- include departments that only exist in drupal_course_catalog
  SELECT
    dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS SIGNED)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS DEPT_BUDGET_CODE
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '') dcc
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ct WHERE ct.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  )
),
subject_codes_by_department AS (
  -- distinct subject codes per department
  SELECT
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_CODE

    course_catalog_subject_offered c
  WHERE
    c.SUBJECT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND c.SUBJECT_CODE <> ''
    AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> ''
  GROUP BY
    c.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    c.SUBJECT_CODE
),
schools_with_polsci AS (
  -- identify schools (SCHOOL_NAME) that have a department named 'Political Science' OR department code '17'
  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(ctso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM
    (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '') ctso
  LEFT JOIN
    (SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM drupal_course_catalog WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL AND DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '') dcc

SELECT

  STDDEV(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev,

  ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE
  d.SCHOOL_NAME IN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME FROM schools_with_polsci)
GROUP BY
  d.SCHOOL_NAME

              ELSE sr.TOTAL_UNITS

rows.question: For each department, provide the department name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units), and the department phone number. Only include departments that have at least one subject with more than 0 total units, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH sis_department_contact AS (
SELECT
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  -- prefer explicit department phone if present, otherwise null string
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, '') AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  -- full name: if there's a formal full name use it, otherwise fallback to department name
  COALESCE(d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  COALESCE(d.SCHOOL_CODE, '') AS SCHOOL_CODE,
  COALESCE(d.SCHOOL_NAME, '') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
  COALESCE(d.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, '') AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM (
  -- base deparment-level selection. Lift any literal values out of view as NULLs/defaults.
  SELECT
    dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- attempt to pick a department phone from known columns if available on source tables;
    -- keep the column so the view remains joinable at department grain
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    -- some systems have a longer full name - preserve if present; otherwise null to allow outer COALESCE to fallback
    NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,

  -- keep one row per department_code by grouping and picking max values for department-level fields
  GROUP BY
    dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE

  sdc.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER

rows.question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with a term status of 'Previous', where the total number of units is greater than 100, and only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each such academic year, report the number of subjects that are classified as undergraduate (HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'), and only include academic years where at least 60% of the subjects are undergraduate. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS_SUM,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_SUBJECTS_TOTAL,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN ccso.SUBJECT_ID END) AS NUM_SUBJECTS_UNDERGRAD,
  -- exact fraction (no rounding) as numeric division
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN ccso.SUBJECT_ID END)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID), 0) AS PCT_UNDERGRAD
FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
JOIN academic_terms all_terms
  ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = all_terms.TERM_CODE
-- bring academic year description from academic_terms_all if present, else from academic_terms
LEFT JOIN academic_terms_all at_all
  ON ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR
LEFT JOIN academic_terms at
  ON ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
-- prefer academic_terms_all description when available
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 1 AS dummy
) d
WHERE
  ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  AND all_terms.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'
GROUP BY
  -- choose the description and academic year code; use COALESCE to prefer academic_terms_all over academic_terms
  COALESCE(at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC),
  COALESCE(at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR)
HAVING
  SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100
  AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN ccso.SUBJECT_ID END)
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID), 0) >= 0.6
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) ASC

rows.question: For each school, what is the geometric mean of the clearing cost collector values for all departments in that school, considering only departments where the clearing cost collector is greater than zero, and excluding the Mathematics department (Course 18)? SELECT

rows.question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Mathematics), show the department name, each subject code, the subject code description, the graduate level of the subject, and the average and variance of the ASCII values of the course numbers for that department's subject codes. WITH subject_course_numbers_raw AS (
  SELECT
    c.SUBJECT_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    c.SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(co.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    COALESCE(co.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME
  FROM cis_course_catalog c
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered co
    ON co.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
    AND (co.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE OR co.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE)
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog d
    ON d.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID
    AND (d.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE OR d.SO_TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE)
  WHERE c.SUBJECT_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
    AND c.SUBJECT_NUMBER <> ''
    AND c.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND c.SUBJECT_ID <> ''
),
department_subjects AS (
  -- derive one row per subject with department info and graduate-level indicator (GIR_ATTRIBUTE used as graduate level per original)
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cs.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`) AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    COALESCE(cs.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, dcc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    cs.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    cs.`SUBJECT_TITLE` AS `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    cs.`SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION` AS `SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION`,
    cs.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    cs.`GIR_ATTRIBUTE` AS `GRADUATE_LEVEL`
  FROM (
    SELECT
      `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
      `SUBJECT_ID`,
      `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
      `SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION`,
      `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
      `GIR_ATTRIBUTE`
    FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
    WHERE `SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
      `SUBJECT_ID`,
      `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
      `SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION`,
      `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
      `GIR_ATTRIBUTE`
  ) AS cs
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
    FROM `cis_course_catalog`
    WHERE `DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
  ) AS dcc
    ON cs.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`
),
chars_exploded AS (
  -- explode each course number to its characters and get ASCII codes
  SELECT
    scr.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    scr.SUBJECT_ID,
    ASCII(SUBSTRING(scr.COURSE_NUMBER, n.n, 1)) AS ascii_val
  FROM subject_course_numbers_raw scr
  JOIN (
    -- numbers 1..30 to cover expected course-number lengths
    SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
    UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25
    UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30
  ) n
    ON n.n <= CHAR_LENGTH(scr.COURSE_NUMBER)
  WHERE scr.COURSE_NUMBER <> ''
),
sub_stats AS (
  -- compute average and variance of ASCII values per offering department and subject
  SELECT
    OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    AVG(ascii_val) AS avg_ascii,
    VARIANCE(ascii_val) AS var_ascii
  FROM chars_exploded
  WHERE ascii_val IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUBJECT_ID
)
SELECT

  ds.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  ds.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION,
  ds.GRADUATE_LEVEL,

  ss.var_ascii
FROM department_subjects ds
LEFT JOIN sub_stats ss
  ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  AND ds.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID
WHERE
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL
  AND ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics'
ORDER BY
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ds.SUBJECT_ID

rows.question: For each academic building at MIT with more than 10 rooms (excluding the 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'), list the building key, building name, building type, the number of historical records, the total assignable area from the building history, and the average assignable area per historical record, but only include buildings where the total assignable area is greater than the average total assignable area across all such buildings. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH mit_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    `BUILDING_NAME`,
    `BUILDING_TYPE`,
    `NUM_OF_ROOMS`
  FROM `fclt_building`
  WHERE `SITE` = 'MIT'
    AND `BUILDING_NAME` <> 'Ray and Maria Stata Center'
    AND `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` <> '32'
    AND `NUM_OF_ROOMS` > 10
),
history AS (
  SELECT
    `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY` AS BUILDING_KEY,
    `ASSIGNABLE_AREA`
  FROM `fclt_building_hist`
),
agg_per_building AS (
  SELECT
    m.BUILDING_KEY,
    m.BUILDING_NAME,
    m.BUILDING_TYPE,
    COUNT(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS HISTORICAL_RECORD_COUNT,
    SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) / COUNT(h.ASSIGNABLE_AREA)
    END AS AVERAGE_ASSIGNABLE_AREA_PER_RECORD
  FROM mit_buildings m
  LEFT JOIN history h
    ON m.BUILDING_KEY = h.BUILDING_KEY
  GROUP BY
    m.BUILDING_KEY,
    m.BUILDING_NAME,
    m.BUILDING_TYPE
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS AVG_TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
  FROM agg_per_building
)
SELECT
  a.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  a.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  a.BUILDING_TYPE AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  a.HISTORICAL_RECORD_COUNT,
  a.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  a.AVERAGE_ASSIGNABLE_AREA_PER_RECORD
FROM agg_per_building a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE a.TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA > o.AVG_TOTAL_ASSIGNABLE_AREA

  d.SCHOOL_NAME,

FROM (

  SELECT DISTINCT
    COALESCE(t.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,

    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered t

  UNION

  ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
CROSS JOIN (SELECT @prev_name := NULL) vars

  -- restrict to graduate students: only count when STUDENT_YEAR = 'G'.

rows.question: For each department, list the department name, the average, range, and variance of the total units for subjects offered in the 2022 academic year that are degree granting and have at least one subject with more than 9 total units, but only include departments that are not 'Mathematics' (Course 18). rows.question: For each department, show the department name, department full name, the number of graduate students in that department whose department is degree granting, and the highest dense rank over the school code among those students, ordered by school code. -- Since the schema provided does not include a student or student-degree table, this query uses only available tables.
-- It builds canonical departments from course catalog tables, infers degree-granting departments by keyword,
-- and returns zeroes for graduate counts and ranks because there is no student data source in the schema.
WITH departments_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    tt.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    NULLIF(tt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' - ', NULLIF(tt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ''), NULLIF(tt.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, '')), '') AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    NULLIF(tt.SCHOOL_NAME, '') AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(tt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') RLIKE '\\b(DEPT|DEPARTMENT|SCHOOL|INSTITUTE|COLLEGE)\\b' THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
      DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
  ) tt
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  0 AS graduate_student_count,
  0 AS max_school_dense_rank
FROM departments_canonical d
WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ASC

rows.question: For each department, what is the department code, department name, and the highest number of enrolled students in any subject offered, for departments that are degree-granting and specifically for the Mathematics department, where the number of enrolled students is between 1 and 10 or the department budget code is at least 90000, and the department budget code is between 90000 and 200000? WITH subject_offered_enrollment AS (
SELECT

  SO.`SECTION_ID`,

  -- raw enrollment count kept as-is for downstream aggregation/filtering
  COALESCE(SO.`NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`, 0) AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`
FROM
  (
    -- base subject offered source: use course_catalog_subject_offered when available (keeps section-level rows),

    SELECT
      CC.`SECTION_ID` AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`, -- carry through as key for this view
      CC.`SECTION_ID`,
      CC.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
      CC.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      NULL AS `OFFERING_DEPT`,
      -- some sources may have enrollment field; use NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS if present, else try to derive from other columns (none in schema),
      -- default to NULL to indicate unknown; caller can filter/aggregate.
      NULL AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`
    FROM
      `course_catalog_subject_offered` CC

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      DC.`SECTION_ID` AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`,
      DC.`SECTION_ID`,
      DC.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
      DC.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
      NULL AS `OFFERING_DEPT`,
      NULL AS `NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS`
    FROM

    -- If there are other subject_offered data sources, add them here following same shape.
  ) SO
)

      )

rows.question: For each building type, what is the building type name, the geometric mean of the area of rooms (AREA) in buildings of that type (considering only rooms with area greater than 0 and buildings with more than 0 rooms), and the average assignable area of those buildings, only including buildings that are academic buildings and are located at MIT? WITH building_room_join AS (
  SELECT
    fr.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
    fr.BUILDING_KEY AS ROOM_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    fb.BUILDING_TYPE,
    fb.SITE,
    fb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    fr.AREA
  FROM fac_rooms fr
  JOIN fac_building fb
    ON fr.BUILDING_KEY = fb.BUILDING_NUMBER
  WHERE COALESCE(fr.AREA, 0) > 0
    AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC'
    AND fb.SITE = 'MIT'
),
per_building AS (
  SELECT
    FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
    BUILDING_TYPE,
    SITE,
    -- keep ASSIGNABLE_AREA so building-level average can be computed; use MAX in case of duplicates
    MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
    COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT,
    SUM(LN(AREA)) AS SUM_LN_AREA,
    COUNT(AREA) AS AREA_COUNT
  FROM building_room_join
  GROUP BY FAC_BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_TYPE, SITE
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
)
SELECT
  pb.BUILDING_TYPE AS BUILDING_TYPE,
  -- geometric mean across all rooms in buildings of this type (unrounded)
  EXP(SUM(pb.SUM_LN_AREA) / SUM(pb.AREA_COUNT)) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_ROOM_AREA,
  -- average assignable area across the qualifying buildings (unrounded)
  AVG(pb.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) AS AVG_ASSIGNABLE_AREA
FROM per_building pb
GROUP BY pb.BUILDING_TYPE

  CAST(coso.SECTION_ID AS CHAR) AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,

  CAST(coso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS CHAR) AS SUBJECT_KEY,

  CAST(coso.SUBJECT_ID AS CHAR) AS SUBJECT_ID,

  -- For portability keep SCHOOL_NAME as the department's high-level school label when available,
  -- otherwise NULL. Consumers should filter SCHOOL_NAME = <school_literal>.
  CASE
    WHEN coso.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN LEFT(coso.DEPARTMENT_CODE,3) IN ('16-', '16_') THEN 'School of Engineering'
    WHEN LEFT(coso.DEPARTMENT_CODE,2) IN ('16') THEN 'School of Engineering'
    ELSE coso.HGN_DESC

  NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,

rows.question: For each degree-granting department (excluding Political Science), list the department name, the total number of unique subject titles they offered with at least one enrolled student, and the total number of enrolled students in those subjects. Additionally, for each school, include a grand total row showing the total number of unique subject titles and total enrolled students across all its degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science). Show only the top 10 departments by unique subject count within each school. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH degree_granting_departments AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `SCHOOL_CODE`,
    `SCHOOL_NAME`,
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
  FROM sis_department
  WHERE `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` IS NOT NULL
    AND `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` <> ''
    AND `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING` <> '0'
    -- exclude Political Science by name OR code
    AND `DEPARTMENT_NAME` <> 'Political Science'
    AND `DEPARTMENT_CODE` <> '17'
),
-- one row per department + subject_title with numeric enrollment summed
department_subject_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ss.SCHOOL_CODE,
    ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ss.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$'
          THEN CAST(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS DECIMAL(38,6))
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_SUM
  FROM subject_summary ss
  WHERE ss.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.SCHOOL_CODE IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    ss.SCHOOL_CODE,
    ss.SCHOOL_NAME,
    ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    ss.SUBJECT_TITLE
),
-- aggregate per department: unique subject count and total enrolled students
department_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    m.SCHOOL_CODE,
    m.SCHOOL_NAME,
    m.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    m.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TITLES,
    SUM(m.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_SUM) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM department_subject_metrics m
  JOIN degree_granting_departments d
    ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    AND m.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE
  WHERE m.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_SUM > 0
  GROUP BY
    m.SCHOOL_CODE,
    m.SCHOOL_NAME,
    m.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    m.DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
-- rank departments within each school by unique_subject_titles desc, then total_enrolled_students desc
ranked_departments AS (
  SELECT
    da.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY da.SCHOOL_CODE
      ORDER BY da.UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TITLES DESC, da.TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM department_aggregates da
),
-- school totals across degree-granting departments (distinct subject titles across the school, and sum enrollments as recorded per subject row)
school_totals AS (
  SELECT
    m.SCHOOL_CODE,
    m.SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TITLES,
    SUM(m.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_SUM) AS TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM department_subject_metrics m
  JOIN degree_granting_departments d
    ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    AND m.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE
  WHERE m.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_SUM > 0
  GROUP BY m.SCHOOL_CODE, m.SCHOOL_NAME
)
-- final output: department rows (top 10 per school) then school total rows
SELECT
  'DEPARTMENT' AS ROW_TYPE,
  rd.SCHOOL_CODE,
  rd.SCHOOL_NAME,
  rd.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  rd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  rd.UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TITLES,
  rd.TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM ranked_departments rd
WHERE rd.rn <= 10

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'SCHOOL_TOTAL' AS ROW_TYPE,
  st.SCHOOL_CODE,
  st.SCHOOL_NAME,
  NULL AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  '<SCHOOL TOTAL>' AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  st.UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TITLES,
  st.TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
FROM school_totals st

ORDER BY
  SCHOOL_CODE,
  -- ensure DEPARTMENT rows come before SCHOOL_TOTAL for each school
  CASE WHEN ROW_TYPE = 'DEPARTMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
  UNIQUE_SUBJECT_TITLES DESC,
  TOTAL_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

rows.question: From the top 10 IAP activities offered in the 2021 January term that are associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, display each activity's title, the term description, the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, and the subject title with the highest lecture units. WITH catalog_subject_course AS (

iap_activity_rows AS (
  SELECT
    IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    TERM_CODE,
    ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    CAST(NULLIF(MAX_ENROLLMENT, '') AS SIGNED) AS MAX_ENROLLMENT,
    CAST(NULLIF(ATTENDANCE, '') AS SIGNED) AS ATTENDANCE,
    CASE
      WHEN IS_CANCELLED IS NULL OR IS_CANCELLED = '' THEN NULL
      WHEN UPPER(IS_CANCELLED) IN ('Y','YES','1','TRUE') THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_CANCELLED,
    LAST_ACTIVITY_DATE
  FROM iap_subject_detail
),
-- For each activity get the max lecture units among linked catalog subjects that are Math and >3 units.
-- NOTE: there is no explicit linking column provided between iap_subject_detail and cis_course_catalog in the schema
-- excerpt; common link is TERM_CODE -> EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE and possibly SUBJECT_ID fields in other schemas.
-- This implementation matches on term and department and assumes an activity is associated to catalog subjects
-- for that term via EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = TERM_CODE. If a more specific linking column exists (e.g. SUBJECT_ID),
-- it should be used instead.
activity_max_units AS (
  SELECT
    a.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    a.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    a.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,

    a.TERM_CODE,

    -- carry through an enrollment metric for ordering (prefer MAX_ENROLLMENT then ATTENDANCE)
    MAX(COALESCE(a.MAX_ENROLLMENT, a.ATTENDANCE, 0)) AS ACTIVITY_RANK_METRIC
  FROM iap_activity_rows a
  JOIN catalog_subject_course c
    ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE

  WHERE a.TERM_CODE = (
    -- pick the TERM_CODE value for the 2021 January (IAP) term from academic_terms

    WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2021' AND TERM_SELECTOR LIKE '%IAP%'
    LIMIT 1
  )
    AND (a.IS_CANCELLED IS NULL OR a.IS_CANCELLED <> 'Y')
  GROUP BY
    a.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    a.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
    a.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY,
    a.ACTIVITY_TITLE,
    a.TERM_CODE
),
-- pick one subject title that attains the max lecture units per activity
subject_with_max AS (

    am.*,
    s.SUBJECT_ID,
    s.SUBJECT_TITLE
  FROM activity_max_units am

    ON s.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = am.TERM_CODE

  GROUP BY

SELECT

rows.question: For each department, provide the department name, the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department, and the corresponding school name, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, and restrict the results to the Mathematics department (Course 18). WITH subject_summary_rows AS (

    CONCAT(COALESCE(ctso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ctso.TERM_CODE, ''), '||', COALESCE(ctso.SUBJECT_ID, '')) AS SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
    -- term and subject identifiers (carry-through for joinability)
    COALESCE(ctso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ctso.TERM_CODE) AS TERM_CODE,
    ctso.SUBJECT_ID,
    -- descriptive fields
    COALESCE(ctso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, dcc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(ctso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, ccc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, dcc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    COALESCE(ctso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcc.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(ctso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- school name (not available in source; keep NULL so columns remain joinable)
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    -- measures: canonical TOTAL_UNITS from available subject-offered / catalog tables
    COALESCE(ctso.TOTAL_UNITS, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS, dcc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    -- warehouse load date: pick most specific available
    COALESCE(ctso.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, ccc.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, dcc.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM
    course_catalog_subject_offered ctso
    LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog ccc
      ON ctso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID
      AND COALESCE(ctso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ctso.TERM_CODE) = ccc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dcc

)

  AND TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) > 5
