    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''),
      NULLIF(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, ''),
      NULLIF(`FAC_BUILDING`.`BUILDING_NAMED_FOR`, '')
    ),
    ''
  ) AS `DLC_NAME`
FROM `fac_building`
GROUP BY `FAC_BUILDING`.`COST_COLLECTOR_KEY`
),
iap_person_roles AS (
SELECT
  isp.IAP_SUBJECT_PERSON_KEY,
  isp.PERSON_ROLE,
  isp.PERSON_NAME,
  isp.PERSON_EMAIL,
  isp.PERSON_ORGANIZATION
FROM
  iap_subject_person isp
WHERE
  isp.PERSON_NAME IS NOT NULL
),
fac_building_with_room_metrics AS (
SELECT
  b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS `FCLT_BUILDING_KEY`,
  b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS `BUILDING_NAME`,
  b.`BUILDING_NUMBER` AS `BUILDING_NUMBER`,
  b.`DATE_BUILT` AS `DATE_BUILT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`ROOM_COUNT`, 0) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
  COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`,
  -- NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY is a simple proxy: one employee per X square feet.
  -- The divisor is a literal and should be supplied/adjusted outside the view if needed.
  -- Here we use 150 sqft per employee as the proxy divisor lifted out as a literal.
  FLOOR(COALESCE(room_aggr.`TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`, 0) / 150) AS `NUM_EMPLOYEES_PROXY`
FROM
  fac_building b
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregated room metrics per building
  SELECT
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`) AS `FAC_BUILDING_KEY`,
    COUNT(*) AS `ROOM_COUNT`,
    -- prefer assignable area where available, else use ext gross area per-room if provided.
    SUM(COALESCE(rb.`ASSIGNABLE_AREA`, rb.`EXT_GROSS_AREA`, 0)) AS `TOTAL_AREA_SQFT`
  FROM
    fac_building rb
  -- rooms may be stored in a related table in some schemas; if there were a fac_room table
  -- you'd aggregate from that table instead. Here we conservatively treat fac_building rows
  -- that include NUM_OF_ROOMS and assignable area as proxies for room-level counts.
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(rb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`, rb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
) room_aggr
  ON room_aggr.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` = b.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
),
library_course_instructor_normalized AS (
SELECT
  -- primary key carried through
  lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY,

  -- raw course name as provided
  lci.COURSE_NAME,

  -- normalized course name: trim, collapse internal spaces, uppercase,
  -- remove punctuation commonly interfering with joins, and keep numeric parts
  UPPER(
    TRIM(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.COURSE_NAME, '[[:punct:]]', ' '),    -- replace punctuation with space
        '\\s+', ' '                                             -- collapse multiple spaces to single
      )
    )
  ) AS COURSE_NAME_NORMALIZED,

  -- raw instructor name as provided
  lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME,

  -- normalized instructor name: trim, collapse spaces, uppercase,
  -- remove punctuation, remove titles (Dr, Prof, Mr, Mrs, Ms) for better matching
  UPPER(
    TRIM(
      REGEXP_REPLACE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
          REGEXP_REPLACE(lci.INSTRUCTOR_NAME, '(?i)\\b(DR|PROF|PROFESSOR|MR|MRS|MS)\\.?\\b', ' '), -- remove common titles
          '[[:punct:]]', ' '                                                          -- replace punctuation
        ),
        '\\s+', ' '
      )
    )
  ) AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME_NORMALIZED,

  -- department and unit carried through (trimmed)
  TRIM(lci.DEPARTMENT) AS DEPARTMENT,
  TRIM(lci.UNIT) AS UNIT,

  -- date range fields: keep as-is but trimmed; consumers can parse further
  TRIM(lci.DATE_FROM) AS DATE_FROM,
  TRIM(lci.DATE_TO) AS DATE_TO

FROM library_course_instructor lci
),
per_year_enrollment_stats AS (
SELECT
  cohort.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  COUNT(*) AS course_count,
  MIN(cohort.enrolled_count) AS enrolled_min,
  MAX(cohort.enrolled_count) AS enrolled_max,
  (MAX(cohort.enrolled_count) - MIN(cohort.enrolled_count)) AS enrolled_range,
  -- population variance (VARIANCE in MySQL returns population variance)
  VARIANCE(cohort.enrolled_count) AS enrolled_variance
FROM
  /* 
    Expectation: caller will supply a cohort of course-offering rows joined to term/academic-year lookup.
    This view aggregates that incoming cohort by ACADEMIC_YEAR.
    The cohort must present columns:
      - ACADEMIC_YEAR
      - enrolled_count  (integer count of enrolled students per course offering)
    Example source could be a subject_offered_fall_math_cohort JOIN term_academic_year_lookup.
  */
  (SELECT
     -- lift cohort columns/literals out of the view: this inner select is a passthrough placeholder
     -- Replace these columns by selecting from the actual cohort relation when using this CTE body.
     NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
     NULL AS enrolled_count
  ) AS cohort
WHERE cohort.ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cohort.ACADEMIC_YEAR
)
SELECT
  p.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  p.enrolled_range,
  p.enrolled_variance,
  CASE
    WHEN p.enrolled_variance >= 1.20 * avg_vars.avg_variance THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE'
    WHEN p.enrolled_variance <= 0.80 * avg_vars.avg_variance THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS variance_category
FROM per_year_enrollment_stats p
JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(enrolled_variance) AS avg_variance
  FROM per_year_enrollment_stats
) avg_vars ON 1=1
ORDER BY p.ACADEMIC_YEAR

rows.question: For each organization, what is the geometric mean of the old department codes for all associated HR organization units where the old department code is greater than zero, excluding organizations '138' and '250', and only for organizations that are not 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'? Additionally, for each result, show the corresponding HR organization unit title and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH dlc_core AS (
  SELECT
    `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` AS DLC_KEY,
    NULLIF(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(`BUILDING_NAME`, ''),
        NULLIF(`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, ''),
        NULLIF(`BUILDING_NAMED_FOR`, '')
      ),
      ''
    ) AS DLC_NAME
  FROM `fac_building`
  WHERE `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY` IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY `COST_COLLECTOR_KEY`
),
hr_org_unit_rows AS (
  SELECT
    hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY,
    hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID,
    hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
    hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD,
    hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    dlc.DLC_KEY,
    hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM `hr_org_unit` hou
  LEFT JOIN dlc_core dlc
    ON dlc.DLC_NAME = hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE
  WHERE hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) <> ''
    AND CAST(TRIM(hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD) AS DECIMAL(38,6)) > 0
),
geom_per_dlc AS (
  SELECT
    h.DLC_KEY,
    EXP(AVG(LN(CAST(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD AS DOUBLE)))) AS geometric_mean_hr_department_code_old
  FROM hr_org_unit_rows h
  WHERE h.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY h.DLC_KEY
)
SELECT
  fo.ORGANIZATION_KEY,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_ID,
  fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
  h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  g.geometric_mean_hr_department_code_old
FROM `fac_organization` fo
LEFT JOIN `fac_building` fb
  ON fb.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fo.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN dlc_core dlc
  ON dlc.DLC_KEY = fb.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY
JOIN hr_org_unit_rows h
  ON h.DLC_KEY = dlc.DLC_KEY
JOIN geom_per_dlc g
  ON g.DLC_KEY = dlc.DLC_KEY
WHERE fo.ORGANIZATION_ID NOT IN ('138','250')
  AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST'
ORDER BY fo.ORGANIZATION_ID, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE

rows.question: For each academic year, show the academic year description, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered in regular terms by the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the total number of Mathematics subjects offered in those terms. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offering_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(`SECTION_ID`,
             CONCAT(`TERM_CODE`, '||', `SUBJECT_ID`, '||', `SECTION_ID`)) AS `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS `COURSE_NUMBER`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `OFFER_DEPT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `OFFER_DEPT_NAME`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `TOTAL_UNITS`,
    `IS_MASTER_SECTION`,
    `IS_LECTURE_SECTION`,
    `IS_LAB_SECTION`,
    `MEET_PLACE`,
    `WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
),
term_regular_indicator AS (
  SELECT
    at.TERM_CODE,
    at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ''), NULLIF(at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, '')) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    at.TERM_START_DATE,
    at.TERM_END_DATE,
    CASE
      WHEN at.IS_REGULAR_TERM IS NULL OR TRIM(at.IS_REGULAR_TERM) = '' THEN 'N'
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(at.IS_REGULAR_TERM)) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','1') THEN 'Y'
      ELSE 'N'
    END AS IS_REGULAR_TERM,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(at.TERM_STATUS, ''), NULLIF(at.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR, '')) AS TERM_STATUS,
    at.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM academic_terms AS at
)
SELECT
  t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  STDDEV(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV_TOTAL_UNITS,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_MATH_SUBJECTS
FROM term_regular_indicator t
JOIN subject_offering_row_level s
  ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'
  AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
ORDER BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC

rows.question: For each type of space usage in the Stata building (excluding usage types that include 'STORAGE'), what is the name of the space usage and the highest variance of the square footage of rooms used for that purpose in any building room, considering only rooms with more than 10 square feet? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  sul.SPACE_USAGE AS SPACE_USAGE,
  MAX(variance_per_room.VAR_ROOM_SQFT) AS MAX_VARIANCE_OF_ROOM_SQFT
FROM (
  SELECT 'ACADEMIC'    AS SPACE_USAGE_KEY, 'Academic'       AS SPACE_USAGE UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ADMIN'       , 'Administrative' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'RESEARCH'    , 'Research' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'LABORATORY'  , 'Laboratory' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'OFFICE'      , 'Office' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'CONFERENCE'  , 'Conference' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'LIBRARY'     , 'Library' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'MECHANICAL'  , 'Mechanical' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'CIRCULATION' , 'Circulation' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'LOBBY'       , 'Lobby' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'RETAIL'      , 'Retail' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'DINING'      , 'Dining' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'RESIDENTIAL' , 'Residential' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ATHLETICS'   , 'Athletics' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PARKING'     , 'Parking' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'EXTERIOR'    , 'Exterior' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'UNASSIGNED'  , 'Unassigned' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'OTHER'       , 'Other'
) AS sul
JOIN (
  -- compute variance of ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE per ROOM_ID within the building and usage
  -- use available columns from schema: many fac_* tables exist; assume space_detail table uses ROOM_ID and ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  SELECT
    sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY,
    sd.ROOM_ID,
    VAR_POP(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS VAR_ROOM_SQFT
  FROM space_detail sd
  WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
    AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10
  GROUP BY sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY, sd.ROOM_ID
) AS variance_per_room
  ON variance_per_room.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = sul.SPACE_USAGE_KEY
WHERE sul.SPACE_USAGE NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%'
GROUP BY sul.SPACE_USAGE

rows.question: For each department, provide the department name, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total number of units for subjects offered by that department (considering only subjects with more than 0 total units and at least 1 enrolled student), and indicate whether the department's average total units is at least 10% higher than the overall average (label as 'HIGH_AVERAGE'), at least 10% lower (label as 'LOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH filtered_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    s.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered s
  WHERE s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
    /* The schema provided does not include a NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS column.
       The user required filtering by NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1, but since that
       column doesn't exist we cannot apply that filter. This CTE applies the
       TOTAL_UNITS > 0 filter only, as in the original query's comment. */
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS OVERALL_AVG_TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM filtered_subjects
)
SELECT
  fs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  fs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  AVG(fs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DEPARTMENT_AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  STDDEV(fs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS DEPARTMENT_STDDEV_TOTAL_UNITS,
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(fs.TOTAL_UNITS) >= os.OVERALL_AVG_TOTAL_UNITS * 1.10 THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE'
    WHEN AVG(fs.TOTAL_UNITS) <= os.OVERALL_AVG_TOTAL_UNITS * 0.90 THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS COMPARISON_LABEL
FROM filtered_subjects fs
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
GROUP BY fs.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, fs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

rows.question: For each department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum total units for subjects offered by that department, considering only departments that have offered more than five subjects, only including subjects offered by the School of Engineering, and only for departments that are degree-granting and are not the Political Science department? Also, for each department, indicate whether the average total units is above 10 ('ABOVE_AVERAGE'), below 6 ('BELOW_AVERAGE'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH sis_degree_granting_departments AS (
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
  FROM `sis_department`
  GROUP BY
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    `IS_DEGREE_GRANTING`
)
SELECT
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  COUNT(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS SUBJECT_COUNT,
  AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MIN_TOTAL_UNITS,
  MAX(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS,
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) > 10 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE'
    WHEN AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) < 6 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS AVG_CLASSIFICATION
FROM
  sis_degree_granting_departments d
JOIN
  subject_summary s
    ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE
  d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
  AND s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'School of Engineering'
GROUP BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
HAVING
  COUNT(s.TOTAL_UNITS) > 5
ORDER BY
  d.DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: How many subjects offered in 2021 that are not for graduate credit, are listed as undergraduate in the course catalog, are in the Mathematics department, and are also offered by the School of Science? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_offered_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(section_id, CONCAT(IFNULL(EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE,''),':',IFNULL(SUBJECT_CODE,''),':',IFNULL(SUBJECT_NUMBER,''),':',IFNULL(SECTION_ID,''))) AS SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY,
    SUBJECT_CODE AS SUBJECT_KEY,
    EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_NUMBER AS COURSE_NUMBER,
    SUBJECT_ID,
    SECTION_ID,
    DEPARTMENT_CODE AS OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    -- there is no explicit SCHOOL column in course_catalog_subject_offered; keep SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES as carried-through field
    SCHOOL_WIDE_ELECTIVES AS OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME,
    RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID,
    MEET_PLACE,
    WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
  WHERE SECTION_ID IS NOT NULL
    AND EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
course_catalog_subject_profile AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, cs.SUBJECT_ID) AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    cs.SUBJECT_ID,
    cs.SUBJECT_CODE,
    cs.SUBJECT_NUMBER,
    COALESCE(cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    -- derive a school name/code: prefer an explicit school-like field when available; fall back to prefix of department code
    CASE
      WHEN cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%School of Science%' THEN 'School of Science'
      WHEN dr.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%School of Science%' THEN 'School of Science'
      WHEN cis.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%School of Science%' THEN 'School of Science'
      WHEN cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE REGEXP '^[A-Z]+' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ' ', 1)
      WHEN dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE REGEXP '^[A-Z]+' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(dr.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ' ', 1)
      WHEN cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE REGEXP '^[A-Z]+' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(cis.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ' ', 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS SCHOOL_NAME,
    COALESCE(cs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dr.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cis.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    COALESCE(cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, dr.SUBJECT_TITLE, cis.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS SUBJECT_TITLE,
    COALESCE(cs.TOTAL_UNITS, dr.TOTAL_UNITS, cis.TOTAL_UNITS) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
    -- GRADE_TYPE may indicate 'Undergraduate' / 'Graduate' in some sources
    COALESCE(cs.GRADE_TYPE, dr.GRADE_TYPE, cis.GRADE_TYPE) AS GRADE_TYPE,
    COALESCE(cs.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, dr.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR, cis.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR) AS IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR,
    COALESCE(cs.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, dr.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, cis.HASS_ATTRIBUTE) AS HASS_ATTRIBUTE,
    COALESCE(cs.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, dr.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, cis.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cs
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dr
    ON dr.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID
    AND dr.SUBJECT_CODE = cs.SUBJECT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog cis
    ON cis.SUBJECT_ID = cs.SUBJECT_ID
    AND cis.SUBJECT_CODE = cs.SUBJECT_CODE
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS subjects_offered_count
FROM subject_offered_row_level s
JOIN course_catalog_subject_profile c
  ON (s.SUBJECT_ID IS NOT NULL AND s.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID)
     OR (s.SUBJECT_ID IS NULL AND s.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = c.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID)
WHERE
  -- term in 2021: match TERM_CODE containing 2021 (covers codes like '2021', 'FALL2021', etc.)
  s.TERM_CODE LIKE '%2021%'
  -- catalog indicates undergraduate; only keep explicit 'Undergraduate' grade type
  AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'Undergraduate'
  -- department is Mathematics
  AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  -- offered by School of Science: match derived SCHOOL_NAME or department name containing 'School of Science'
  AND (
    c.SCHOOL_NAME = 'School of Science'
    OR c.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%School of Science%'
    OR s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME LIKE '%School of Science%'
  )

rows.question: For students whose year is 'G' and whose department is degree-granting and is 'Political Science', show their full name, email address, department name, subject code, and subject code description, and for each department, also show the total number of such students in that department. Only include students whose department code is '17'. Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subject_code_reference AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cc.`SUBJECT_CODE`, cis.`SUBJECT_CODE`, dcc.`SUBJECT_CODE`) AS SUBJECT_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cis.`SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`, ''),
             NULLIF(cc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, ''),
             NULLIF(cca.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, ''),
             NULLIF(dcc.`SUBJECT_TITLE`, ''),
             '') AS SUBJECT_CODE_DESC,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, ''),
             NULLIF(cca.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, ''),
             NULLIF(dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, ''),
             NULLIF(cis.`DEPARTMENT_CODE`, ''),
             '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, ''),
             NULLIF(cca.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, ''),
             NULLIF(dcc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, ''),
             NULLIF(cis.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, ''),
             '') AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT `SUBJECT_CODE`, `SUBJECT_TITLE`, `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`, `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered
    WHERE `SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT `SUBJECT_CODE`, `SUBJECT_TITLE`, `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`, `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
    FROM cis_course_catalog
    WHERE `SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT `SUBJECT_CODE`, `SUBJECT_TITLE`, NULL AS `SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE`, `DEPARTMENT_CODE`, `DEPARTMENT_NAME`
    FROM drupal_course_catalog
    WHERE `SUBJECT_CODE` IS NOT NULL
  ) AS cc
  LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog AS cis
    ON cis.`SUBJECT_CODE` = cc.`SUBJECT_CODE`
       AND (cis.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` OR cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NULL)
  LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered AS cca
    ON cca.`SUBJECT_CODE` = cc.`SUBJECT_CODE`
       AND (cca.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` OR cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NULL)
  LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS dcc
    ON dcc.`SUBJECT_CODE` = cc.`SUBJECT_CODE`
       AND (dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` OR cc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` IS NULL)
),
dept_counts AS (
  -- count graduate students in department 17
  SELECT
    `DEPARTMENT` AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COUNT(*) AS DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT
  FROM mit_student_directory
  WHERE `STUDENT_YEAR` = 'G'
    AND `DEPARTMENT` = '17'
  GROUP BY `DEPARTMENT`
)
SELECT
  m.`FULL_NAME`,
  m.`EMAIL_ADDRESS`,
  s.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
  r.`SUBJECT_CODE`,
  r.`SUBJECT_CODE_DESC`,
  dc.`DEPARTMENT_STUDENT_COUNT`
FROM mit_student_directory AS m
JOIN employee_directory AS s
  ON m.`DEPARTMENT` = s.`DEPARTMENT_NUMBER`
LEFT JOIN subject_code_reference AS r
  ON r.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = m.`DEPARTMENT`
JOIN dept_counts AS dc

WITH subject_summary_department_term_units AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(cc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, cs.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`) AS `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    so.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
    so.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(so.`TOTAL_UNITS`, ''),
        NULLIF(cs.`TOTAL_UNITS`, ''),
        (COALESCE(so.`LECTURE_UNITS`,0) + COALESCE(so.`LAB_UNITS`,0) + COALESCE(so.`PREPARATION_UNITS`,0)),
        (COALESCE(cs.`LECTURE_UNITS`,0) + COALESCE(cs.`LAB_UNITS`,0) + COALESCE(cs.`PREPARATION_UNITS`,0)),
        0
      )
    ) AS `TOTAL_UNITS`
  FROM
    course_catalog_subject_offered AS so
    LEFT JOIN cis_course_catalog AS cc
      ON cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = so.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
      OR (cc.`SUBJECT_CODE` = so.`SUBJECT_CODE` AND cc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` = so.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`)
    LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog AS cs
      ON cs.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = so.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
      OR (cs.`SUBJECT_CODE` = so.`SUBJECT_CODE` AND cs.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` = so.`SUBJECT_NUMBER`)
  GROUP BY
    so.`TERM_CODE`,
    so.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    COALESCE(cc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, cs.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`)
),
per_year_term_totals AS (
  SELECT
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC` AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    at.`TERM_CODE` AS TERM_CODE,
    SUM(st.`TOTAL_UNITS`) AS TERM_TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM subject_summary_department_term_units st
  JOIN academic_terms_all at
    ON st.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
  WHERE st.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
  GROUP BY at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR`, at.`ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`, at.`TERM_CODE`
),
per_year_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    p.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    VARIANCE(p.TERM_TOTAL_UNITS) AS variance_units,
    STDDEV(p.TERM_TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_units,
    MAX(p.TERM_TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units,
    MIN(p.TERM_TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_units,
    COUNT(*) AS terms_count
  FROM per_year_term_totals p
  GROUP BY p.ACADEMIC_YEAR, p.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
),
overall_avg_stddev AS (
  SELECT AVG(stddev_units) AS avg_stddev
  FROM per_year_stats
)
SELECT
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  s.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  (s.max_units - s.min_units) AS `RANGE`,
  s.variance_units AS VARIANCE,
  s.stddev_units AS STDDEV,
  CASE
    WHEN s.stddev_units >= 1.2 * o.avg_stddev THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY'
    WHEN s.stddev_units <= 0.8 * o.avg_stddev THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'

FROM per_year_stats s
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_stddev o
WHERE s.terms_count > 0

rows.question: For each degree-granting department, what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in undergraduate subjects offered by that department, and which departments have an average enrollment greater than the overall average for all degree-granting departments? WITH dept_undergrad_enroll AS (
  SELECT
    cc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    cc.`SUBJECT_ID`,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.`MIT_ID`) AS enrolled_students
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cc
  JOIN cis_course_catalog c ON c.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` = cc.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID`
    AND c.`SUBJECT_ID` = cc.`SUBJECT_ID`
  LEFT JOIN (
    -- assume an enrollment-like table does not exist in schema; simulate by sections with RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID as student surrogate is not appropriate.
    -- Instead treat rows in course_catalog_subject_offered as one enrolled student each (best-effort given schema)
    SELECT `SECTION_ID`, `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID` FROM course_catalog_subject_offered WHERE `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID` IS NOT NULL
  ) e ON e.`SECTION_ID` = cc.`SECTION_ID`
  WHERE cc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` IS NOT NULL
    AND cc.`SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    -- restrict to undergraduate subjects: assume SUBJECT_NUMBER numeric and < 5000 indicates undergrad; cast safely
    AND (CAST(cc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS SIGNED) < 5000 OR cc.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,4}$')
  GROUP BY cc.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`, cc.`SUBJECT_ID`
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    AVG(d.`enrolled_students`) AS avg_enrollment,
    VARIANCE(d.`enrolled_students`) AS var_enrollment,
    STDDEV(d.`enrolled_students`) AS stddev_enrollment
  FROM dept_undergrad_enroll d
  GROUP BY d.`DEPARTMENT_NAME`
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_enrollment) AS overall_avg_enrollment
  FROM dept_stats
)
SELECT

  ds.`var_enrollment`,

WITH academic_year_terms AS (
  SELECT
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
    `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC`,
    `TERM_CODE`
  FROM `academic_terms`
  WHERE `ACADEMIC_YEAR` IS NOT NULL
),
subject_summary_fall_offerings AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(`SECTION_ID`, CONCAT(`SUBJECT_ID`, '|', `TERM_CODE`)) AS `SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY`,
    `TERM_CODE`,
    `SUBJECT_ID`,
    `SUBJECT_TITLE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
    `DEPARTMENT_NAME`,
    COALESCE(`TOTAL_UNITS`, (`LECTURE_UNITS` + `LAB_UNITS`), 0) AS `TOTAL_UNITS`
  FROM `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  WHERE `TERM_CODE` IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      `IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM` = 'Y'
      OR `TERM_CODE` IN (
        SELECT `TERM_CODE` FROM `academic_terms` WHERE `TERM_DESCRIPTION` LIKE '%Fall%' OR `TERM_CODE` LIKE '%F%'
      )
    )
    AND `SUBJECT_ID` IS NOT NULL
    AND `DEPARTMENT_NAME` = 'Mathematics'
),
-- Filter by library reserve status = 'U'
-- Use LEFT JOIN/INNER JOIN depending on presence; using INNER JOIN to enforce the MATERIAL_STATUS = 'U' predicate.
filtered_math_fall AS (
  SELECT
    ssf.*,
    ayt.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ayt.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
  FROM subject_summary_fall_offerings AS ssf
  JOIN academic_year_terms AS ayt
    ON ssf.TERM_CODE = ayt.TERM_CODE
  JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
    ON ssf.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID
    AND ssf.TERM_CODE = lrmd.TERM_CODE
  JOIN `library_material_status` lms
    ON lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
  WHERE lms.`MATERIAL_STATUS` = 'U'
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_total
  FROM filtered_math_fall
)
SELECT
  f.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  f.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  AVG(f.TOTAL_UNITS) AS AVG_TOTAL_UNITS,
  STDDEV(f.TOTAL_UNITS) AS STDDEV_TOTAL_UNITS,
  CASE
    WHEN AVG(f.TOTAL_UNITS) >= 1.10 * oa.overall_avg_total THEN 'HIGH_AVERAGE'
    WHEN AVG(f.TOTAL_UNITS) <= 0.90 * oa.overall_avg_total THEN 'LOW_AVERAGE'

  END AS AVERAGE_CATEGORY
FROM filtered_math_fall f
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
GROUP BY f.ACADEMIC_YEAR, f.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, oa.overall_avg_total
ORDER BY f.ACADEMIC_YEAR

      COALESCE(cc.SUBJECT_ID, dc.SUBJECT_ID, cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS SUBJECT_ID,
      COALESCE(cc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      COALESCE(cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      COALESCE(cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
      COALESCE(cc.TOTAL_UNITS, cso.TOTAL_UNITS, dc.TOTAL_UNITS, 0) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
      COALESCE(cc.LECTURE_UNITS, cso.LECTURE_UNITS, dc.LECTURE_UNITS, 0) AS LECTURE_UNITS,
      COALESCE(cc.LAB_UNITS, cso.LAB_UNITS, dc.LAB_UNITS, 0) AS LAB_UNITS,
      COALESCE(cc.PREPARATION_UNITS, cso.PREPARATION_UNITS, dc.PREPARATION_UNITS, 0) AS PREPARATION_UNITS,
      COALESCE(cc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, dc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM) AS IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM
    FROM cis_course_catalog cc
    LEFT JOIN course_catalog_subject_offered cso
      ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID
      AND cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = cc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    LEFT JOIN drupal_course_catalog dc
      ON dc.SUBJECT_ID = cc.SUBJECT_ID
      AND dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = cc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      cso.TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
      cso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
      cso.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
      cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
      COALESCE(cso.TOTAL_UNITS, 0) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
      COALESCE(cso.LECTURE_UNITS, 0) AS LECTURE_UNITS,
      COALESCE(cso.LAB_UNITS, 0) AS LAB_UNITS,
      COALESCE(cso.PREPARATION_UNITS, 0) AS PREPARATION_UNITS,
      cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM
    FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cso
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM cis_course_catalog cc2
      WHERE cc2.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID
        AND cc2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE
    )

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AS TERM_CODE,
      dc.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
      dc.SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID,
      dc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS ACADEMIC_YEAR,
      dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
      dc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
      COALESCE(dc.TOTAL_UNITS, 0) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
      COALESCE(dc.LECTURE_UNITS, 0) AS LECTURE_UNITS,
      COALESCE(dc.LAB_UNITS, 0) AS LAB_UNITS,
      COALESCE(dc.PREPARATION_UNITS, 0) AS PREPARATION_UNITS,
      dc.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM AS IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM
    FROM drupal_course_catalog dc
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM cis_course_catalog cc3
      WHERE cc3.SUBJECT_ID = dc.SUBJECT_ID
        AND cc3.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM course_catalog_subject_offered cso2
        WHERE cso2.SUBJECT_ID = dc.SUBJECT_ID
          AND cso2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = dc.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
      )
  ) cs
  GROUP BY
    cs.TERM_CODE,
    cs.SUBJECT_ID,
    cs.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
    cs.ACADEMIC_YEAR
)
SELECT
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  MIN(s.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS MIN_ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  SUM(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS SUM_TOTAL_UNITS
FROM subject_unit_summary s
WHERE
  (
    -- prefer explicit fall indicator when available
    s.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y'
    -- or infer from term code containing typical fall markers (e.g. 'F' or 'FA')
    OR s.TERM_CODE LIKE '%F%'
    OR s.TERM_CODE LIKE '%FA%'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lr
    JOIN library_material_status ms
      ON lr.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY
    WHERE lr.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
      AND lr.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
      AND ms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_CODE = 'U'
  )
GROUP BY
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY
  s.DEPARTMENT_NAME

rows.question: For each department that grants degrees (excluding Chemistry and Biology), what is the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students in subjects offered by that department, along with the department's full name, the school name, and the number of unique subjects offered by the department, considering only departments that offer more than 5 unique subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH subjects AS (
  -- Use course_catalog_subject_offered as the source of subjects offered by departments.
  -- This table contains SUBJECT_ID, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME and TOTAL_UNITS (used only if no enrollment source).
  SELECT
    COALESCE(ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, '') AS DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    COALESCE(ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '') AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, -- no SCHOOL_NAME column is available in the provided schema
    ccso.SUBJECT_ID,
    -- There is no explicit NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS column in the provided schema.
    -- To keep the query syntactically correct and produce numeric aggregates,
    -- we will prefer a column named NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS if present; otherwise fall back to TOTAL_UNITS;
    -- if neither is present, treat as NULL so it will be ignored by AVG/VARIANCE/STDDEV.
    NULLIF(
      COALESCE(
        -- attempt to reference common possible enrollment columns; if they don't exist, COALESCE will skip them
        NULLIF(NULL, NULL), -- placeholder to keep syntax when unknown columns are not present
        ccso.TOTAL_UNITS
      ), 
      ''
    ) + 0 AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM course_catalog_subject_offered ccso
  WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
    s.SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
    AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS AVG_NUM_ENROLLED,
    VARIANCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS VAR_NUM_ENROLLED,
    STDDEV(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS STDDEV_NUM_ENROLLED
  FROM subjects s
  WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_CODE NOT IN ('5','7') -- exclude Chemistry (5) and Biology (7)
  GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME
)
SELECT
  DEPARTMENT_CODE,
  DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME,
  SCHOOL_NAME,
  NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS,
  AVG_NUM_ENROLLED,
  VAR_NUM_ENROLLED,
  STDDEV_NUM_ENROLLED
FROM dept_stats
WHERE NUM_UNIQUE_SUBJECTS > 5
  -- Exclude organizations '101' and '103' if an ORGANIZATION_ID were available/joined.
  -- The provided schema has no ORGANIZATION_ID on the tables used, so this filter cannot be applied here.

rows.question: For each floor in the Stata building (building 32), what is the largest room square footage and the name of the building room with that largest square footage, for rooms loaded into the warehouse on 19-DEC-24, with a largest room square footage greater than 100, and also display the total number of rooms on that floor that meet these criteria? Do not return any rounded answers.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH space_floor_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` AS FLOOR_KEY,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, ''), fb.`BUILDING_NAME`) AS FLOOR,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME_LONG`, ''),
      NULLIF(fb.`BUILDING_NAME`, ''),
      CASE
        WHEN fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` <> '' AND fb.`BUILDING_NAME` IS NOT NULL AND fb.`BUILDING_NAME` <> ''
          THEN CONCAT('Bldg ', fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`, ' - ', fb.`BUILDING_NAME`)
        WHEN fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` IS NOT NULL AND fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER` <> ''
          THEN CONCAT('Bldg ', fb.`BUILDING_NUMBER`)
        ELSE fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY`
      END
    ) AS FLOOR_NAME,
    fb.`WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE`
  FROM fac_building fb
  WHERE fb.`FAC_BUILDING_KEY` IS NOT NULL
),
-- use space_detail table (assumed present) filtered to Stata building, load date, and sqft > 100
filtered_spaces AS (
  SELECT
    sd.*,
    sfl.FLOOR,
    sfl.FLOOR_NAME
  FROM space_detail sd
  LEFT JOIN space_floor_lookup sfl ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sfl.FLOOR_KEY
  WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = '32'
    AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24'
    AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100
),
per_floor_agg AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(FLOOR, FLOOR_KEY) AS FLOOR_ID, -- carry an id so joins remain joinable
    FLOOR AS FLOOR_LABEL,
    FLOOR_NAME,
    MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
    COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT_ON_FLOOR
  FROM filtered_spaces
  GROUP BY COALESCE(FLOOR, FLOOR_KEY), FLOOR, FLOOR_NAME
)
SELECT
  p.FLOOR_LABEL AS FLOOR,
  p.LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE,
  -- choose a deterministic room name for the largest square footage: smallest BUILDING_ROOM when ties
  fs_max.BUILDING_ROOM AS BUILDING_ROOM_WITH_MAX_SQFT,
  p.ROOM_COUNT_ON_FLOOR
FROM per_floor_agg p
LEFT JOIN (
  -- find the room on that floor matching the max sqft; deterministic pick by MIN(BUILDING_ROOM)
  SELECT
    f.FLOOR AS FLOOR_LABEL,
    f.BUILDING_ROOM,
    f.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
  FROM filtered_spaces f
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(FLOOR, FLOOR_KEY) AS FLOOR_ID,
      MAX(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS max_sqft
    FROM filtered_spaces
    GROUP BY COALESCE(FLOOR, FLOOR_KEY)
  ) m ON COALESCE(f.FLOOR, f.FLOOR_KEY) = m.FLOOR_ID
     AND f.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = m.max_sqft
  ORDER BY f.FLOOR, f.BUILDING_ROOM
) fs_max ON fs_max.FLOOR_LABEL = p.FLOOR_LABEL
ORDER BY p.FLOOR_LABEL
